guide.summary: Chinese prepositions (coverbs) such as 在, 给, 跟, 对, 从, 离, 往, 用 set the scene for the action: where, with whom, to whom, from where, with what. The scene comes first, so the coverb phrase stands BEFORE the verb, not after it as in English. Only a place or person that the action ends up at (放在, 送到, 寄给) follows the verb.

subs.label: Coverb phrase before the verb
subs.focus: Force the learner to place the 在 / 跟 / 和 / 给 phrase between the subject (and time word) and the verb. Classic mistake: English order with the phrase at the end (我吃饭在家, 我见面朋友). Mostly order and judge items; do not use 住 or other verbs that also allow the phrase after them.

subs.label: Where 不, 没, 也, 都 and modals go
subs.focus: Force the choice of slot for 不 / 没 / 也 / 都 / 常常 / 想 / 要 relative to the coverb phrase. With action verbs they go before the coverb (没给他打电话, not 给他没打电话). With adjective-type predicates (对…好, 离…远, 跟…一样, 对…感兴趣) 不 and 很 go on the predicate (对我不好, 离这儿不远). Classic mistake: mixing the two up.

subs.label: 从 vs 离 (and 从…到)
subs.focus: Force the choice between 从 (starting point of movement or of a time span, often paired with 到) and 离 (the distance or time gap between two points, followed by 远 / 近 / 有 + amount / 还有). Classic mistake: 我家从学校很远, because both translate as 'from'.

subs.label: 对 vs 跟 / 和 vs 给
subs.focus: Choose the coverb from the predicate: 对 for attitude or effect (对我很好, 对…感兴趣, 对身体好); 跟 / 和 for mutual acts (见面, 聊天, 结婚, 商量); 给 for a recipient (打电话, 写信, 介绍, 买). Classic mistakes: 跟音乐感兴趣, 对他打电话. Never set 跟 against 和, or 跟他说 against 对他说 (both fine).

subs.label: 往 vs 向 vs 朝
subs.focus: Choose among 往, 向, 朝: 往 needs a direction or place plus a movement verb (往左拐); 向 and 朝 can take a person; only 向 goes with abstract verbs (向他学习, 向你道歉). Classic mistakes: 往他学习, 往我笑. Never set 向 against 朝, or any of the three against each other in 往 / 向 / 朝前走.

subs.label: 为 and 替
subs.focus: Force 为 for the person behind a feeling or service (为你高兴, 为他担心, 为大家服务) and 替 for acting in someone's place (替我去开会, 替我向他问好). Classic mistake: 对你高兴, or the phrase after the verb. Never set 替 against 给 in favours where both work (替我买 / 给我买).

subs.label: 用 (tool) and 坐 (transport)
subs.focus: Force 用 + tool and 坐 + vehicle before the main verb (用筷子吃饭, 坐地铁去上班), and the choice of 用 / 坐 / 骑. Classic mistakes: 用地铁去, 坐自行车. Test order with order and rewrite items; do not write judge items calling 我去上班坐地铁 wrong, since it can occur in contrast.

subs.label: 在 / 到 / 给 after the verb
subs.focus: Force 在 / 到 / 给 directly after a placement or transfer verb when the phrase says where the thing ends up: 放在, 坐在, 写在, 挂在; 送到, 搬到; 寄给, 送给, 交给, 发给, 还给. Usually with 把 for a definite object. Classic mistakes: 我放书在桌子上, 我送他在机场 for 送到机场.

rules.rule: Where an activity happens goes before the verb: 在 + place, then the action.

examples.py: wǒ zài jiā chī fàn
examples.en: I eat at home.

examples.py: tā zài tú shū guǎn kàn shū
examples.en: He is reading in the library.

examples.zh: 我们中午在公司附近吃饭。
examples.py: wǒ men zhōng wǔ zài gōng sī fù jìn chī fàn
examples.en: We eat near the office at noon.

rules.note: A few verbs of staying in a position, above all 住, allow both orders: 我住在北京 and 我在北京住 are both correct.

rules.rule: The person you do something with comes before the verb with 跟 or 和; 一起 follows that phrase.
rules.pattern: Subject + 跟 / 和 + person + (一起) + Verb

examples.py: wǒ míng tiān gēn péng you jiàn miàn
examples.en: I'm meeting a friend tomorrow.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ liáo tiān
examples.en: I'd like to chat with you.

examples.zh: 她周末跟同学一起去看电影。
examples.py: tā zhōu mò gēn tóng xué yī qǐ qù kàn diàn yǐng
examples.en: She is going to see a film with classmates at the weekend.

rules.note: 见面, 聊天, 结婚 cannot take the other person as an object: never 见面朋友 or 结婚他.

rules.rule: The tool (用) or the vehicle (坐) is stated first, then what you do with it.
rules.pattern: Subject + 用 + tool + Verb / Subject + 坐 + vehicle + 去 / 来 / 上班 …

examples.py: zhōng guó rén yòng kuài zi chī fàn
examples.en: Chinese people eat with chopsticks.

examples.py: wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě shàng bān
examples.en: I go to work by subway every day.

examples.py: nǐ kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī fù qián
examples.en: You can pay with your phone.

rules.note: Bicycles take 骑 (骑自行车去), and driving yourself is 开车去. The reversed order (我去上班坐地铁) only appears in special contrastive contexts; treat the tool-first order as the rule.

rules.rule: With an action verb, 不, 没, 也, 都, 常常 and modal verbs (想, 要, 能, 可以) normally go before the coverb, not before the main verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + 不 / 没 / 也 / 都 / modal + coverb + noun + Verb

examples.py: wǒ bù zài jiā chī wǎn fàn
examples.en: I don't eat dinner at home.

examples.py: tā zuó tiān méi gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
examples.en: He didn't call me yesterday.

examples.py: wǒ yě xiǎng gēn nǐ men yī qǐ qù
examples.en: I want to go with you too.

rules.note: A default, not an iron law: 也, 都 and 常常 can also follow the phrase (我在家也喝茶), and 不 after a 在 + place phrase is natural in contrast (我在家不吃午饭). With 没 + 给 / 跟 + action verb, keep 没 in front.

rules.rule: When the predicate is an adjective or a state (好, 远, 近, 一样, 感兴趣), 不 and 很 go on that predicate, after the coverb phrase.
rules.pattern: Subject + 对 / 离 / 跟 + noun + 不 / 很 + adjective

examples.py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào bù yuǎn
examples.en: My home is not far from school.

examples.py: wǒ duì zú qiú bù gǎn xìng qù
examples.en: I'm not interested in football.

examples.py: wǒ de xiǎng fǎ gēn nǐ bù yī yàng
examples.en: My idea is different from yours.

rules.note: 也 and 都 can go before or after the coverb phrase here: 他也对我很好 / 他对我也很好.

rules.rule: 从 marks the point where movement or a period starts; 到 marks where it ends.

examples.zh: 从北京到上海要五个小时。
examples.py: cóng běi jīng dào shàng hǎi yào wǔ gè xiǎo shí
examples.en: It takes five hours from Beijing to Shanghai.

examples.py: tā gāng cóng gōng sī huí lai
examples.en: He has just come back from the office.

examples.py: wǒ men cóng bā diǎn kāi shǐ shàng kè
examples.en: We start class at eight.

rules.rule: 离 measures the gap between two points in space or time. Nothing moves; it is followed by 远, 近, 有 + distance, or 还有 + time.
rules.pattern: A + 离 + B + 很远 / 很近 / 有 + distance / 还有 + time

examples.py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn
examples.en: My home is close to school.

examples.zh: 这儿离机场有二十公里。
examples.py: zhè r lí jī chǎng yǒu èr shí gōng lǐ
examples.en: It is twenty kilometres from here to the airport.

examples.py: lí kǎo shì hái yǒu sān tiān
examples.en: There are still three days until the exam.

rules.rule: 对 marks the target of an attitude, a feeling or an effect.
rules.pattern: Subject + 对 + noun + 很 + adjective / 感兴趣 / 有帮助

examples.py: lǎo shī duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
examples.en: The teacher is very good to us.

examples.zh: 他对中国历史很感兴趣。
examples.py: tā duì zhōng guó lì shǐ hěn gǎn xìng qù
examples.en: He is very interested in Chinese history.

examples.py: duō hē shuǐ duì shēn tǐ hǎo
examples.en: Drinking more water is good for your health.

rules.rule: 跟 / 和 marks a partner in something mutual; 给 marks the person who receives a call, a message, a thing or a service.
rules.pattern: 跟 / 和 + person + 见面 / 聊天 / 商量 / 结婚 ; 给 + person + 打电话 / 写信 / 发邮件 / 介绍 / 买

examples.py: wǒ wǎn shang gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
examples.en: I'll call you tonight.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ shāng liang yī jiàn shì
examples.en: I'd like to discuss something with you.

examples.zh: 请给我们介绍一下这个地方。
examples.py: qǐng gěi wǒ men jiè shào yī xià zhè ge dì fang
examples.en: Please tell us a bit about this place.

rules.note: With 说 both 跟他说 and 对他说 are standard (给他说 is regional). 打电话给他 is also heard, but 给他打电话 is the default order; 跟他打电话 is common in speech too.

rules.rule: 往 takes a direction or place and a verb of movement. 向 and 朝 can also face a person, and only 向 is used with abstract verbs such as 学习, 道歉, 问好, 介绍.
rules.pattern: 往 + direction + movement verb ; 向 / 朝 + person + Verb ; 向 + person + 学习 / 道歉

examples.py: dào le lù kǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi
examples.en: Turn left when you get to the junction.

examples.py: nǐ yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu jiù dào le
examples.en: Just keep walking straight ahead and you'll be there.

examples.py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng tā xué xí
examples.en: We should learn from him.

examples.py: tā cháo wǒ xiào le xiào
examples.en: She gave me a smile.

rules.note: For plain physical direction the three overlap: 往前走, 向前走 and 朝前走 are all correct. 朝 stresses facing a direction and is the most colloquial.

rules.rule: 为 names the person or cause you feel something for or serve; 替 means doing it in that person's place.
rules.pattern: Subject + 为 + person + 高兴 / 担心 / 服务 ; Subject + 替 + person + Verb

examples.py: wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
examples.en: I'm really happy for you.

examples.py: bié wèi wǒ dān xīn
examples.en: Don't worry about me.

examples.py: nǐ néng tì wǒ qù kāi huì ma
examples.en: Can you go to the meeting in my place?

examples.py: qǐng tì wǒ xiàng tā wèn hǎo
examples.en: Please say hello to him for me.

rules.note: For everyday favours 给 and 替 often both work (给我买一杯咖啡 / 替我买一杯咖啡); 替 adds the idea 'so that I don't have to'.

rules.rule: If the phrase says where the thing or person ends up as a result of the action, 在 / 到 / 给 attaches right after the verb; a definite object moves forward with 把.
rules.pattern: 把 + object + 放 / 写 + 在 + place ; 送 / 搬 + 到 + place ; 寄 / 发 / 交 + 给 + person

examples.py: qǐng bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
examples.en: Please put the book on the table.

examples.py: wǒ bǎ tā sòng dào jī chǎng le
examples.en: I took him to the airport.

examples.py: wǒ bǎ zhào piàn fā gěi nǐ le
examples.en: I've sent you the photos.

examples.py: nǐ zuò zài zhè r ba
examples.en: Sit here.

rules.note: Compare: 我在桌子上写字 (the writing happens at the table) and 把名字写在书上 (the name ends up on the book). Nothing may come between the verb and 在 / 到 / 给, and 了 follows the whole unit.

contrasts.why: The place of an activity is scene-setting, so 在家 must stand before 吃饭. English puts 'at home' last; Chinese does not.

right.py: wǒ míng tiān gēn péng you jiàn miàn

contrasts.why: 见面 cannot take an object. The other person is introduced with 跟 or 和 before the verb.

right.py: wǒ méi gěi tā dǎ diàn huà

contrasts.why: With an action verb, 没 and 不 normally go before the coverb phrase, not between it and the verb.

right.en: He is not nice to me.

contrasts.why: 好 is an adjective predicate, so 不 goes directly on it, after 对我. The same holds for 离…不远 and 跟…不一样.

right.py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn yuǎn
right.en: My home is far from school.

contrasts.why: Distance between two points is 离. 从 is only for a starting point of movement or time.

contrasts.wrong: 离北京到上海要五个小时。

right.zh: 从北京到上海要五个小时。
right.py: cóng běi jīng dào shàng hǎi yào wǔ gè xiǎo shí
right.en: It takes five hours from Beijing to Shanghai.

contrasts.why: A route with a start and an end is 从…到. 离 does not pair with 到.

right.py: wǒ duì yīn yuè hěn gǎn xìng qù

contrasts.why: Interest is an attitude toward something, so it takes 对. 跟 is for a partner in a mutual activity.

right.py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng tā xué xí

contrasts.why: 往 needs a direction or place and real movement. With a person and an abstract verb like 学习, only 向 works.

right.py: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
right.en: I put the book on the table.

contrasts.why: The table is where the book ends up, so 在 attaches directly to 放. In standard Mandarin the object does not sit between them; it moves forward with 把.

right.py: wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng

contrasts.why: Feeling something on someone's account takes 为. 对 would point the feeling at the person, which 高兴 does not allow.

cheat: Where, with whom, to whom, with what: say it BEFORE the verb.
不 / 没 / 也 / 都 / 想 go before the coverb with action verbs; 不 and 很 go on the adjective (对我不好, 离这儿不远).
How far or how long until? 离. Starting point, often with 到? 从.
Attitude or effect: 对. Doing it together: 跟 / 和. Someone receives it: 给.
往 + direction + movement. Person plus 学习 / 道歉 / 问好: 向.
Happy or worried for someone: 为. In someone's place: 替.
The thing ends up there: 放在, 送到, 寄给 after the verb, usually with 把.

items.q: 他昨天___我商量了很久，最后决定换工作。
items.zh: 他昨天跟我商量了很久，最后决定换工作。
items.py: tā zuó tiān gēn wǒ shāng liáng le hěn jiǔ zuì hòu jué dìng huàn gōng zuò
items.en: He discussed it with me for a long time yesterday and finally decided to change jobs.
items.why: 商量 is a two-sided act with a partner, so 跟 comes before it. 给 and 对 cannot mark a discussion partner.

items.q: 我们几个同事中午常常___公司附近的饭馆吃饭。
items.zh: 我们几个同事中午常常在公司附近的饭馆吃饭。
items.py: wǒ men jǐ gè tóng shì zhōng wǔ cháng cháng zài gōng sī fù jìn de fàn guǎn chī fàn
items.en: We colleagues often eat at a restaurant near the company at noon.
items.why: The location of an ongoing habit takes 在 before 吃饭. 往 would need a movement verb, and 对 and 给 need a person.

items.zh: 请把这些文件放在经理的桌子上。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè xiē wén jiàn fàng zài jīng lǐ de zhuō zi shàng
items.en: Please put these documents on the manager's desk.
items.why: 放在 stays together right after the 把 object, and the place it ends up goes after it.

items.q: 我每天___地铁上班。
items.zh: 我每天坐地铁上班。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě shàng bān
items.en: I take the subway to work every day.
items.why: Riding in a public vehicle is 坐 + vehicle, before the movement. 骑 is for bicycles and 开 is for driving it yourself.

items.q: 你可以___手机付钱，不用带现金。
items.zh: 你可以用手机付钱，不用带现金。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī fù qián bù yòng dài xiàn jīn
items.en: You can pay with your phone; you do not need to carry cash.
items.why: The phone is the tool used for paying, so 用 + 手机. 坐 and 骑 are for transport, and 给手机 would mean giving the phone away.

items.q: 我今天迟到了，所以___老师道歉了。
items.zh: 我今天迟到了，所以向老师道歉了。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān chí dào le suǒ yǐ xiàng lǎo shī dào qiàn le
items.en: I was late today, so I apologised to the teacher.
items.why: 道歉 is an abstract act directed at a person, and only 向 fits that. 往 needs a direction, and 从 and 离 are about starting points and distance.

items.zh: 小李明天跟老师见面。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ míng tiān gēn lǎo shī jiàn miàn
items.en: Xiao Li is meeting the teacher tomorrow.
items.why: The partner phrase 跟老师 comes before 见面, which cannot take an object. 见面老师 is a classic error.

items.q: 她___我笑了笑，什么也没说。
items.zh: 她朝我笑了笑，什么也没说。
items.py: tā cháo wǒ xiào le xiào shén me yě méi shuō
items.en: She smiled at me and did not say anything.
items.why: 朝 + person faces the person with the gesture. 往 does not take a person, 跟 would need a partner, and 离 is a distance word.

items.s: 我们吃午饭在食堂。
items.s_py: wǒ men chī wǔ fàn zài shí táng
items.zh: 我们在食堂吃午饭。
items.py: wǒ men zài shí táng chī wǔ fàn
items.en: We eat lunch in the canteen.
items.why: The place of the activity must come before the verb. 在食堂 cannot follow 吃午饭.

items.src_py: wǒ qù xué xiào
items.zh: 我坐公共汽车去学校。
items.py: wǒ zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù xué xiào
items.en: I take the bus to school.
items.why: The vehicle phrase 坐公共汽车 goes before the movement verb 去.

items.q: 小王每天早上___教室读英语。
items.zh: 小王每天早上在教室读英语。
items.py: xiǎo wáng měi tiān zǎo shàng zài jiào shì dú yīng yǔ
items.en: Xiao Wang reads English in the classroom every morning.
items.why: Where an activity takes place is set before the verb with 在. 给 and 对 need a person, and 往 needs a direction plus movement, so none of them can introduce the place of 读英语.

items.s: 到了前面的路口，你往右拐。
items.zh: 到了前面的路口，你往右拐。
items.py: dào le qián miàn de lù kǒu nǐ wǎng yòu guǎi
items.en: When you get to the junction ahead, turn right.
items.why: 往 + direction + movement verb 拐 is exactly the right pattern, so the sentence is correct.

items.zh: 我打算坐火车去北京参加面试。
items.py: wǒ dǎ suàn zuò huǒ chē qù běi jīng cān jiā miàn shì
items.en: I plan to take the train to Beijing for an interview.
items.why: The modal 打算 goes first, then the vehicle phrase 坐火车 before the movement verb 去.

items.q: 老师___我们介绍了一位新同学。
items.zh: 老师给我们介绍了一位新同学。
items.py: lǎo shī gěi wǒ men jiè shào le yī wèi xīn tóng xue
items.en: The teacher introduced a new classmate to us.
items.why: 介绍 something to someone takes 给 for the recipient. 跟我们 would make us co-introducers, and 往 cannot take a person.

items.q: 她把照片发___我了。
items.zh: 她把照片发给我了。
items.py: tā bǎ zhào piān fā gěi wǒ le
items.en: She has sent me the photos.
items.why: The person who receives the photos follows 发 directly as 发给. 在 would need a place, and 往 does not take a person.

items.q: 小王想___女朋友结婚，可是他还没有钱。
items.zh: 小王想跟女朋友结婚，可是他还没有钱。
items.py: xiǎo wáng xiǎng gēn nǚ péng you jié hūn kě shì tā hái méi yǒu qián
items.en: Xiao Wang wants to marry his girlfriend, but he has no money yet.
items.why: 结婚 cannot take an object; the other person is marked with 跟 / 和. 给 and 对 do not fit a mutual event.

items.src_py: tā zuó tiān gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà le
items.zh: 他昨天没给我打电话。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
items.en: He did not call me yesterday.
items.why: Negating a past action uses 没 before 给我 and drops 了. 给我没打电话 is wrong.

items.src_py: wǒ zài jiā chī wǔ fàn
items.zh: 我不在家吃午饭。
items.py: wǒ bù zài jiā chī wǔ fàn
items.en: I do not eat lunch at home.
items.why: 不 normally goes before the coverb phrase 在家 and negates the whole action; 吃不在家 is wrong. 我在家不吃午饭 is also possible, but it means 'when I am at home I do not eat lunch'.

items.zh: 学生们常常用电脑写作业。
items.py: xué sheng men cháng cháng yòng diàn nǎo xiě zuò yè
items.en: The students often do their homework on the computer.
items.why: The tool phrase 用电脑 sits between the adverb 常常 and the verb 写作业.

items.q: 他的意见跟我的___一样，所以我们吵了起来。
items.zh: 他的意见跟我的不一样，所以我们吵了起来。
items.py: tā de yì jiàn gēn wǒ de bù yí yàng suǒ yǐ wǒ men chǎo le qǐ lái
items.en: His opinion is different from mine, so we ended up arguing.
items.why: 一样 is a state predicate, so 不 goes on it after 跟我的. 没一样 is not used, and 都 would say they match, which contradicts the argument.

items.s: 她不在这家公司工作了。
items.zh: 她不在这家公司工作了。
items.py: tā bù zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le
items.en: She no longer works at this company.
items.why: 不 goes before the coverb 在这家公司, and 了 marks the change. This is correct.

items.q: 我已经___经理发了一封邮件。
items.zh: 我已经给经理发了一封邮件。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng gěi jīng lǐ fà le yī fēng yóu jiàn
items.en: I have already sent the manager an email.
items.why: The manager receives the email, so the recipient is marked with 给. 跟 would make the manager a partner in the act, and 往 cannot take a person.

items.zh: 你一直往前走。
items.py: nǐ yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu
items.en: Just keep going straight ahead.
items.why: 一直 comes before the coverb phrase 往前, which comes before the movement verb 走.

items.zh: 同事们下午在会议室讨论新计划。
items.py: tóng shì men xià wǔ zài huì yì shì tǎo lùn xīn jì huà
items.en: The colleagues are discussing the new plan in the meeting room this afternoon.
items.why: Subject, time, then the 在 phrase, then the verb and object. 在会议室 cannot follow 讨论 here.

items.src_py: wǒ míng tiān jiàn lǐ lǎo shī
items.task: Rewrite with 跟 and 见面.
items.zh: 我明天跟李老师见面。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān gēn lǐ lǎo shī jiàn miàn
items.en: I am meeting Teacher Li tomorrow.
items.why: 见面 takes no object, so the person becomes 跟李老师 before the verb.

items.q: 老板对员工一点儿都___好，所以大家都想离开这家公司。
items.zh: 老板对员工一点儿都不好，所以大家都想离开这家公司。
items.py: lǎo bǎn duì yuán gōng yì diǎn r dōu bù hǎo suǒ yǐ dà jiā dōu xiǎng lí kāi zhè jiā gōng sī
items.en: The boss is not nice to the staff at all, so everyone wants to leave the company.
items.why: 一点儿都 needs a negative, and for the adjective 好 that is 不, placed on it after 对员工. 太 and 很 are positive and 别 is a command.

items.s: 我住在学校附近。
items.zh: 我住在学校附近。
items.py: wǒ zhù zài xué xiào fù jìn
items.en: I live near the school.
items.why: 住 is one of the verbs that allows 在 + place right after it, so this is correct. Do not mark it wrong just because the place follows the verb.

items.q: 我们应该___那位老师学习，他工作非常认真。
items.zh: 我们应该向那位老师学习，他工作非常认真。
items.py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng nà wèi lǎo shī xué xí tā gōng zuò fēi cháng rèn zhēn
items.en: We should learn from that teacher; he works very conscientiously.
items.why: Learning from a person uses 向 + person + 学习. 往 only goes with directions and movement, and 离 is a distance word.

items.q: 咖啡店离办公室___远，走两分钟就到。
items.zh: 咖啡店离办公室不远，走两分钟就到。
items.py: kā fēi diàn lí bàn gōng shì bù yuǎn zǒu liǎng fēn zhōng jiù dào
items.en: The cafe is not far from the office; it is a two-minute walk.
items.why: 远 is an adjective predicate, so the negative 不 sits right on it, after 离办公室. 没 negates 有 or past events, and the walking time shows it is not 很 far.

items.q: 小王对我很好，小李___对我很好。
items.zh: 小王对我很好，小李也对我很好。
items.py: xiǎo wáng duì wǒ hěn hǎo xiǎo lǐ yě duì wǒ hěn hǎo
items.en: Xiao Wang is very nice to me, and Xiao Li is also very nice to me.
items.why: Adverbs like 也 go before the coverb: 也对我很好. 都 needs a plural subject, and 又 and 才 do not mean "too" here.

items.q: 这本书___学习汉语很有帮助。
items.zh: 这本书对学习汉语很有帮助。
items.py: zhè běn shū duì xué xí hàn yǔ hěn yǒu bāng zhù
items.en: This book is very helpful for learning Chinese.
items.why: The effect on a purpose or person is 对 + noun + 有帮助. 跟 would mean "together with learning Chinese".

items.q: 这儿___火车站有五公里，打车比较方便。
items.zh: 这儿离火车站有五公里，打车比较方便。
items.py: zhè r lí huǒ chē zhàn yǒu wǔ gōng lǐ dǎ chē bǐ jiào fāng biàn
items.en: It is five kilometres from here to the train station, so a taxi is more convenient.
items.why: The gap between two fixed points followed by 有 + distance is 离. 从 would need a movement verb and an endpoint.

items.s: 他对我也很好。
items.zh: 他对我也很好。
items.py: tā duì wǒ yě hěn hǎo
items.en: He is also very nice to me.
items.why: 也 may stand before the coverb (他也对我很好) or right after the coverb phrase (他对我也很好), and 很 stays on 好. Both are normal, so this is correct.

items.q: 我想___同学一起准备考试。
items.zh: 我想跟同学一起准备考试。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn tóng xue yì qǐ zhǔn bèi kǎo shì
items.en: I want to prepare for the exam together with my classmates.
items.why: 一起 asks for a partner in a shared activity, which is 跟 (or 和). 给 would make the classmates recipients, and 对 only marks an attitude or effect.

items.q: 同学们把桌子搬___另一个教室了。
items.zh: 同学们把桌子搬到另一个教室了。
items.py: tóng xue men bǎ zhuō zi bān dào lìng yí gè jiào shì le
items.en: The students moved the desks to another classroom.
items.why: 搬 + 到 + place says where the desks end up after being carried. 搬在 is not used, and 给 would need a person.

items.q: 妈妈每个星期都___我寄一些水果。
items.zh: 妈妈每个星期都给我寄一些水果。
items.py: mā mā měi gè xīng qī dōu gěi wǒ jì yī xiē shuǐ guǒ
items.en: My mother sends me some fruit every week.
items.why: The recipient of the parcel is introduced with 给 before 寄. 跟 would need a partner, and 往 does not take a person.

items.s: 我跟中文很感兴趣。
items.s_py: wǒ gēn zhōng wén hěn gǎn xìng qù
items.zh: 我对中文很感兴趣。
items.py: wǒ duì zhōng wén hěn gǎn xìng qù
items.en: I am very interested in Chinese.
items.why: 感兴趣 needs 对 for its object. 跟 marks a partner in a shared act.

items.q: 我们都___他的健康担心。
items.zh: 我们都为他的健康担心。
items.py: wǒ men dōu wèi tā de jiàn kāng dān xīn
items.en: We are all worried about his health.
items.why: The person you worry about is introduced with 为 before 担心. 给 needs a recipient and 往 needs a direction, and 从 marks a starting point, so none of them fits a worry.

items.zh: 我昨天没给他打电话。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi gěi tā dǎ diàn huà
items.en: I did not call him yesterday.
items.why: 没 goes before the coverb 给他, not between 给他 and 打电话. 给他没打电话 is a classic error.

items.q: 我想___你聊聊天。
items.zh: 我想跟你聊聊天。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ liáo liáo tiān
items.en: I would like to chat with you.
items.why: 聊天 is a mutual act, so the other person is marked with 跟 / 和. 给你聊天 and 对你聊天 do not work.

items.s: 我们学校从火车站很远。
items.s_py: wǒ men xué xiào cóng huǒ chē zhàn hěn yuǎn
items.zh: 我们学校离火车站很远。
items.py: wǒ men xué xiào lí huǒ chē zhàn hěn yuǎn
items.en: Our school is far from the train station.
items.why: Distance between two places is 离. 从 only marks a starting point.

items.s: 我们公司离地铁站不远。
items.zh: 我们公司离地铁站不远。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn
items.en: Our company is not far from the subway station.
items.why: 远 is the adjective predicate, so 不 sits on it after 离地铁站. This is correct.

items.s: 你考了第一名，我真对你高兴。
items.s_py: nǐ kǎo le dì yì míng wǒ zhēn duì nǐ gāo xìng
items.zh: 你考了第一名，我真为你高兴。
items.py: nǐ kǎo le dì yì míng wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
items.en: You came first; I am really happy for you.
items.why: Being happy on someone's account takes 为. 对你高兴 does not exist.

items.q: 请把你的名字写___这张纸上。
items.zh: 请把你的名字写在这张纸上。
items.py: qǐng bǎ nǐ de míng zì xiě zài zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng
items.en: Please write your name on this sheet of paper.
items.why: The paper is where the name ends up, so 在 attaches directly to 写. 给 would mean writing it for someone, and 从 marks a starting point.

items.q: 我明天有点儿事，你能___我去开会吗？
items.zh: 我明天有点儿事，你能替我去开会吗？
items.py: wǒ míng tiān yǒu diǎn r shì nǐ néng tì wǒ qù kāi huì ma
items.en: I have something on tomorrow; can you go to the meeting in my place?
items.why: Going in someone's place, so that they do not have to, is 替. 给我去开会 is not a way to say someone goes in your place.

items.q: 李老师昨天___上海出差回来，今天下午就给我们上课。
items.zh: 李老师昨天从上海出差回来，今天下午就给我们上课。
items.py: lǐ lǎo shī zuó tiān cóng shàng hǎi chū chāi huí lái jīn tiān xià wǔ jiù gěi wǒ men shàng kè
items.en: Teacher Li came back from a business trip in Shanghai yesterday and is teaching us this afternoon.
items.why: The place the return trip starts from is 从. 离 would state a distance, and 往 points toward a destination, not the origin.

items.s: 我放书在桌子上了。
items.s_py: wǒ fàng shū zài zhuō zi shàng le
items.zh: 我把书放在桌子上了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
items.en: I have put the book on the table.
items.why: 在 attaches directly to 放, and the object moves forward with 把. 放书在 splits them.

items.q: 老板把这个文件交___我了。
items.zh: 老板把这个文件交给我了。
items.py: lǎo bǎn bǎ zhè ge wén jiàn jiāo gěi wǒ le
items.en: The boss handed this document over to me.
items.why: 交 something to a person takes 给 right after the verb, with 把 for the definite object. 在 and 到 mark places, not a person who receives.

items.q: 你一直___前走，银行就在左边。
items.zh: 你一直往前走，银行就在左边。
items.py: nǐ yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu yín háng jiù zài zuǒ biān
items.en: Just keep walking straight ahead; the bank is on the left.
items.why: 往前走 gives the direction of a movement. 在前走 would put the verb in the wrong frame, and 对 and 给 need a person.

items.s: 他给我没发邮件。
items.s_py: tā gěi wǒ méi fā yóu jiàn
items.zh: 他没给我发邮件。
items.py: tā méi gěi wǒ fā yóu jiàn
items.en: He did not send me an email.
items.why: 没 belongs before the coverb 给我, not between 给我 and 发.

items.q: 考试的时候，老师不让我们___手机查词典。
items.zh: 考试的时候，老师不让我们用手机查词典。
items.py: kǎo shì de shí hou lǎo shī bù ràng wǒ men yòng shǒu jī chá cí diǎn
items.en: During the exam the teacher does not let us use our phones to look things up in a dictionary.
items.why: The phone is the tool for looking up words, so 用手机 comes before 查. 坐 and 骑 are for vehicles.

items.q: 老师___我们很好。
items.zh: 老师对我们很好。
items.py: lǎo shī duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
items.en: The teacher is very good to us.
items.why: 对 marks the target of an attitude or treatment: 对我们很好. 给 needs a thing or action that is handed over.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ wén jiàn jiāo gěi jīng lǐ
items.task: Say you have not done it yet.
items.zh: 我还没把文件交给经理。
items.py: wǒ hái méi bǎ wén jiàn jiāo gěi jīng lǐ
items.en: I have not handed the document to the manager yet.
items.why: 还没 goes before 把, and 交给 stays together after the 把 object.

items.q: 我弟弟___数学很感兴趣。
items.zh: 我弟弟对数学很感兴趣。
items.py: wǒ dì di duì shù xué hěn gǎn xìng qù
items.en: My younger brother is very interested in maths.
items.why: 感兴趣 is an attitude toward something, so it needs 对. 跟 is for a partner and 给 for a recipient.

items.src_py: tú shū guǎn lí jiào shì hěn jìn
items.zh: 图书馆离教室不近。
items.py: tú shū guǎn lí jiào shì bù jìn
items.en: The library is not close to the classroom.
items.why: Replace 很 with 不 on the adjective 近, after the coverb phrase 离教室.

items.q: 从公司___我家要坐四十分钟地铁。
items.zh: 从公司到我家要坐四十分钟地铁。
items.py: cóng gōng sī dào wǒ jiā yào zuò sì shí fēn zhōng dì tiě
items.en: It takes forty minutes by subway from the company to my home.
items.why: The pair is 从 … 到 for start and end of a route. 离 does not pair with 从, and 往 and 对 do not mark an endpoint.

items.q: 我们开车把客人送___机场，然后才回公司。
items.zh: 我们开车把客人送到机场，然后才回公司。
items.py: wǒ men kāi chē bǎ kè rén sòng dào jī chǎng rán hòu cái huí gōng sī
items.en: We drove the guests to the airport and only then went back to the company.
items.why: The airport is where the guests end up after being taken, so 送到. 送给 would mean giving something to a person, and 送在 is not used.

items.q: 我已经___导师商量过毕业论文的题目了。
items.zh: 我已经跟导师商量过毕业论文的题目了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng gēn dǎo shī shāng liáng guò bì yè lùn wén de tí mù le
items.en: I have already discussed the topic of my graduation thesis with my supervisor.
items.why: 商量 is a two-way act, so the partner is introduced by 跟 / 和. 给 would make the supervisor a mere recipient, and 对 marks an attitude, not a partner.

items.zh: 我每天在图书馆学习。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zài tú shū guǎn xué xí
items.en: I study in the library every day.
items.why: The place phrase 在图书馆 stands before 学习, and the time word comes before it. Putting 在图书馆 after the verb is English order and wrong.

items.q: 经理出差了，这个星期的会议由我___他主持。
items.zh: 经理出差了，这个星期的会议由我替他主持。
items.py: jīng lǐ chū chāi le zhè ge xīng qī de huì yì yóu wǒ tì tā zhǔ chí
items.en: The manager is away on a trip, so I will chair this week's meeting in his place.
items.why: 主持 done in his place is 替他. 对 and 往 do not express acting on behalf of someone.

items.s: 我们开车把同事送在火车站了。
items.s_py: wǒ men kāi chē bǎ tóng shì sòng zài huǒ chē zhàn le
items.zh: 我们开车把同事送到火车站了。
items.py: wǒ men kāi chē bǎ tóng shì sòng dào huǒ chē zhàn le
items.en: We drove our colleague to the train station.
items.why: Taking someone to a place is 送到. 送在 is not used.

items.q: 听说你考上了大学，我真___你高兴。
items.zh: 听说你考上了大学，我真为你高兴。
items.py: tīng shuō nǐ kǎo shàng le dà xué wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
items.en: I heard you got into university; I am really happy for you.
items.why: Feeling happy on someone's account takes 为. 对你高兴 does not exist, and 给 and 往 do not fit a feeling.

items.s: 我把名字写在书上了。
items.zh: 我把名字写在书上了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ míng zì xiě zài shū shàng le
items.en: I wrote my name in the book.
items.why: The book is where the name ends up, so 在 attaches to 写 after 把. This is the correct pattern.

items.s: 我们要往老师学习。
items.s_py: wǒ men yào wǎng lǎo shī xué xí
items.zh: 我们要向老师学习。
items.py: wǒ men yào xiàng lǎo shī xué xí
items.en: We should learn from the teacher.
items.why: 往 needs a direction or place and a movement verb. Learning from a person is 向.

items.s: 他昨天跟我说了这件事。
items.zh: 他昨天跟我说了这件事。
items.py: tā zuó tiān gēn wǒ shuō le zhè jiàn shì
items.en: He told me about this yesterday.
items.why: With 说 the person can be marked with 跟 as well as 对, so this is correct.

items.q: 经理明天要___客户见面。
items.zh: 经理明天要跟客户见面。
items.py: jīng lǐ míng tiān yào gēn kè hù jiàn miàn
items.en: The manager is going to meet a client tomorrow.
items.why: 见面 is mutual and cannot take an object, so the other person comes in with 跟 before the verb. 给客户 or 对客户 cannot sit in front of 见面.

items.zh: 请替我向他问好。
items.py: qǐng tì wǒ xiàng tā wèn hǎo
items.en: Please say hello to him for me.
items.why: 替我 means in my place and comes before 向他, which in turn comes before the verb 问好.

items.q: 你家___公司远不远？
items.zh: 你家离公司远不远？
items.py: nǐ jiā lí gōng sī yuǎn bù yuǎn
items.en: Is your home far from the company?
items.why: A question about distance between two places uses 离 with 远 / 近. 从 and 在 need a movement or a location of an action.

items.s: 离考试还有三天。
items.zh: 离考试还有三天。
items.py: lí kǎo shì hái yǒu sān tiān
items.en: There are still three days until the exam.
items.why: 离 + event + 还有 + time is the standard way to count the time left, so no 从 is needed here.

items.q: 到了十字路口，你___右拐。
items.zh: 到了十字路口，你往右拐。
items.py: dào le shí zì lù kǒu nǐ wǎng yòu guǎi
items.en: When you reach the crossroads, turn right.
items.why: 往 + direction + movement verb is the pattern for turning or going. 对, 给 and 跟 do not take a direction.

items.q: 我感冒了，小王___我请了一天假。
items.zh: 我感冒了，小王替我请了一天假。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào le xiǎo wáng tì wǒ qǐng le yī tiān jiǎ
items.en: I have a cold, so Xiao Wang asked for a day off for me, in my place.
items.why: Doing the errand in place of the sick person is 替. 对 and 往 do not mark a stand-in, and 离 is a distance word.

items.q: 我们___八点开始上课。
items.zh: 我们从八点开始上课。
items.py: wǒ men cóng bā diǎn kāi shǐ shàng kè
items.en: We start class at eight.
items.why: 从 marks the point where a period starts. 离 gives the gap between two points and cannot be followed by 开始 like this.

items.q: 我们每周___周一___周五都有课。
items.zh: 我们每周从周一到周五都有课。
items.py: wǒ men měi zhōu cóng zhōu yī dào zhōu wǔ dōu yǒu kè
items.en: We have classes every week from Monday to Friday.
items.why: 从 starts the span and 到 ends it, in that order. 离 cannot form a span of time, and swapping the two words reverses the span.

items.q: 今天晚上我___跟同学一起复习，你也来吧。
items.zh: 今天晚上我要跟同学一起复习，你也来吧。
items.py: jīn tiān wǎn shàng wǒ yào gēn tóng xue yì qǐ fù xí nǐ yě lái ba
items.en: I am going to review with my classmates tonight; come along too.
items.why: A modal like 要 goes before 跟同学. 不 and 没 would cancel the plan, which clashes with 你也来吧, and 别 is a command, not a statement about me.

items.q: 你放心吧，别___我担心。
items.zh: 你放心吧，别为我担心。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn ba bié wèi wǒ dān xīn
items.en: Do not worry about me; stop worrying.
items.why: 担心 on someone's account is 为我担心. 对 and 往 do not mark the cause of a worry.

items.src_py: wǒ tì nǐ qù kāi huì
items.task: Turn it into a question with 能.
items.zh: 我能替你去开会吗？
items.py: wǒ néng tì nǐ qù kāi huì ma
items.en: Can I go to the meeting in your place?

items.zh: 我想跟你商量一件事。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ shāng liáng yī jiàn shì
items.en: I would like to discuss something with you.
items.why: The modal 想 goes before the coverb phrase 跟你, and 商量 follows the partner phrase directly.

items.zh: 新办公室离地铁站不远。
items.py: xīn bàn gōng shì lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn
items.en: The new office is not far from the subway station.
items.why: 远 is an adjective predicate, so 不 goes right before it, after 离地铁站.

items.zh: 他对音乐很感兴趣。
items.py: tā duì yīn yuè hěn gǎn xìng qù
items.en: He is very interested in music.
items.why: 对音乐 comes right after the subject, and 很 goes before the predicate 感兴趣.

items.q: ___考试还有两个星期，我们得好好复习。
items.zh: 离考试还有两个星期，我们得好好复习。
items.py: lí kǎo shì hái yǒu liǎng gè xīng qī wǒ men děi hǎo hǎo fù xí
items.en: There are two weeks left until the exam, so we have to review properly.
items.why: 离 + event + 还有 + time counts the gap before the event. 从 would mark a start, not the time that remains.

items.q: 他刚___图书馆回来。
items.zh: 他刚从图书馆回来。
items.py: tā gāng cóng tú shū guǎn huí lái
items.en: He has just come back from the library.
items.why: The library is the place the movement starts from, so 从. 离 is for distance and 在图书馆回来 would be ungrammatical.

items.zh: 从公司到我家要四十分钟。
items.py: cóng gōng sī dào wǒ jiā yào sì shí fēn zhōng
items.en: It takes forty minutes from the company to my home.
items.why: 从 + start and 到 + end come first, as the topic of the route, and the time taken follows with 要.

items.s: 请替我向经理问好。
items.zh: 请替我向经理问好。
items.py: qǐng tì wǒ xiàng jīng lǐ wèn hǎo
items.en: Please say hello to the manager for me.
items.why: 替我 gives the stand-in and 向经理 gives the person addressed, both before 问好. This is the correct order.

items.src_py: xué xiào lí wǒ jiā hěn yuǎn
items.task: Turn it into an A-not-A question.
items.zh: 学校离我家远不远？

items.en: Is the school far from my home?
items.why: The A-not-A question repeats the predicate 远不远 after the coverb phrase 离我家.

items.q: 中国人常常___筷子吃饭。
items.zh: 中国人常常用筷子吃饭。
items.py: zhōng guó rén cháng cháng yòng kuài zi chī fàn
items.en: Chinese people often eat with chopsticks.
items.why: A tool is introduced with 用 before the verb: 用筷子吃饭. 坐 is for vehicles you ride in and 骑 is for bikes and horses.

items.q: 新来的同事___大家都很客气，也很愿意帮助别人。
items.zh: 新来的同事对大家都很客气，也很愿意帮助别人。
items.py: xīn lái de tóng shì duì dà jiā dōu hěn kè qi yě hěn yuàn yì bāng zhù bié rén
items.en: The new colleague is polite to everyone and willing to help others.
items.why: Politeness is an attitude toward people, so 对大家 comes before the adjective. 给 would need a handed-over thing.

items.s: 我明天见面老师。
items.s_py: wǒ míng tiān jiàn miàn lǎo shī
items.zh: 我明天跟老师见面。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān gēn lǎo shī jiàn miàn
items.en: I am meeting the teacher tomorrow.
items.why: 见面 cannot take an object; the other person needs 跟 / 和 before the verb.

items.q: ___暑假开始只剩一个星期了，同学们都在计划去哪儿玩。
items.zh: 离暑假开始只剩一个星期了，同学们都在计划去哪儿玩。
items.py: lí shǔ jià kāi shǐ zhǐ shèng yí gè xīng qī le tóng xue men dōu zài jì huà qù nǎ r wán
items.en: Only one week is left before the summer holiday starts, and everyone is planning where to go.
items.why: The time still remaining before an event is 离 + event + 只剩 / 还有 + time. 从 would mean "starting from the holiday", which does not fit 只剩.

items.q: 我们明天___公共汽车去北京大学。
items.zh: 我们明天坐公共汽车去北京大学。
items.py: wǒ men míng tiān zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù běi jīng dà xué
items.en: We are taking the bus to Peking University tomorrow.
items.why: Travelling by bus is 坐 + vehicle before 去. 用公共汽车 would treat the bus as a tool, and 骑 is for bicycles.

items.s: 老师用电脑给我们放电影。
items.zh: 老师用电脑给我们放电影。
items.py: lǎo shī yòng diàn nǎo gěi wǒ men fàng diàn yǐng
items.en: The teacher plays a film for us on the computer.
items.why: Two coverb phrases can stack before one verb: the tool 用电脑 first, then the recipient 给我们.

items.q: 多睡觉___身体好。
items.zh: 多睡觉对身体好。
items.py: duō shuì jiào duì shēn tǐ hǎo
items.en: Sleeping more is good for your health.
items.why: The effect on the body is 对身体好. 跟 would mean "together with the body", and 给 means to give.

items.q: 你___在这儿大声说话，同学们正在考试。
items.zh: 你别在这儿大声说话，同学们正在考试。
items.py: nǐ bié zài zhè r dà shēng shuō huà tóng xue men zhèng zài kǎo shì
items.en: Do not talk loudly here; the students are taking an exam.
items.why: An order not to do something uses 别, and it goes before the coverb phrase: 别在这儿说话. 没 is for past facts and 也 and 很 make no sense as a command.

items.q: 小李___办公室里打印文件。
items.zh: 小李在办公室里打印文件。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ zài bàn gōng shì lǐ dǎ yìn wén jiàn
items.en: Xiao Li is printing documents in the office.
items.why: The place where the printing happens is 在 + place before the verb. 给, 跟 and 向 all need a person, not a room.

items.src_py: lǎo shī duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
items.task: Say the teacher is also good to us.
items.zh: 老师也对我们很好。
items.py: lǎo shī yě duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
items.en: The teacher is also very nice to us.
items.why: 也 can go before the coverb 对我们 or right after it; either way 很 stays on the adjective 好 and 对我们 stays before the predicate.

items.q: 他喜欢___自行车去学校。
items.zh: 他喜欢骑自行车去学校。
items.py: tā xǐ huān qí zì xíng chē qù xué xiào
items.en: He likes riding his bicycle to school.
items.why: A bicycle is ridden, so 骑 + 自行车. 开 is for driving a car, and 坐 does not describe sitting astride a bike.

items.q: 我家___学校很近，走路五分钟。
items.zh: 我家离学校很近，走路五分钟。
items.py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng
items.en: My home is close to school; it is a five-minute walk.
items.why: Nothing moves here: the sentence gives the gap between two places, which is 离 + 近. 从 needs a starting point of movement.

items.zh: 我把照片发给你了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ zhào piān fā gěi nǐ le
items.en: I have sent you the photos.
items.why: 发给 stays together as one unit after 把照片, and 了 goes after the recipient at the end.

items.q: 妈妈___厨房做饭。
items.zh: 妈妈在厨房做饭。
items.en: Mom is cooking in the kitchen.
items.why: 在 + place sets where the action happens and stands before 做饭. 跟 and 给 need a person, and 从 marks a starting point, not the location of an activity.

items.q: 我周末___爷爷奶奶一起吃饭。
items.zh: 我周末跟爷爷奶奶一起吃饭。
items.en: I eat with my grandparents at the weekend.
items.why: A companion in a shared activity takes 跟 before the verb, and 一起 follows it. 给 would make the grandparents recipients, and 在 needs a place, not people.

items.q: 我们___超市门口等你。
items.zh: 我们在超市门口等你。
items.en: We'll wait for you at the supermarket entrance.
items.why: The place where the waiting happens takes 在 before 等. 往 and 从 describe movement toward or away from a place, and 离 measures distance, none of which fits standing still.

items.q: 姐姐昨天___商场买了一条裙子。
items.zh: 姐姐昨天在商场买了一条裙子。
items.en: My older sister bought a skirt at the mall yesterday.
items.why: The mall is where the buying took place, so 在商场 stands before 买. 给 would name who the skirt was for, and 跟 or 对 need a person, not a place.

items.q: 周末我常常___女朋友的父母一起在家包饺子。
items.zh: 周末我常常跟女朋友的父母一起在家包饺子。
items.en: At weekends I often make dumplings at home together with my girlfriend's parents.
items.why: 一起 signals a shared activity, so the partner is introduced by 跟 before the verb. 给 and 对 aim the action at a person instead of doing it together, and 向 means toward.

items.q: 昨天晚上我___给妈妈打电话，她有点生气。

items.en: I didn't call Mom last night, and she was a bit upset.
items.why: 昨天 makes it a past event that did not happen, so 没 goes before the coverb phrase 给妈妈. 不 is for habit or will, and 别 is a command.

items.q: 我家离地铁站___远，走路五分钟。
items.zh: 我家离地铁站不远，走路五分钟。
items.en: My home is not far from the subway station; it's a five-minute walk.
items.why: 远 is an adjective predicate, so 不 goes directly in front of it, after 离地铁站. 很 and 太 would say it is far, which clashes with five minutes on foot.

items.q: 我对做饭___感兴趣，所以天天点外卖。
items.zh: 我对做饭不感兴趣，所以天天点外卖。
items.en: I'm not interested in cooking, so I order takeaway every day.
items.why: 对做饭 comes first, then 不 goes right before 感兴趣. 很, 也 and 都 cannot give a reason for ordering takeaway every day.

items.q: 姐姐对我很好，哥哥___对我很好。
items.zh: 姐姐对我很好，哥哥也对我很好。
items.en: My older sister is very good to me, and my older brother is also very good to me.
items.why: 也 adds a second person to the same statement and sits before the coverb 对我. 都 needs a plural subject, and 才 and 又 do not mean also.

items.q: 爸爸、妈妈和我___在阳台上喝茶。
items.zh: 爸爸、妈妈和我都在阳台上喝茶。
items.en: Dad, Mom and I are all having tea on the balcony.
items.why: 都 sums up the three people and, like every adverb, comes before the coverb 在阳台上. 也 would mean someone else already does it, which the cue does not say.

items.q: 这件衣服的价钱跟那件___一样，那件便宜一些。
items.zh: 这件衣服的价钱跟那件不一样，那件便宜一些。
items.en: This coat's price isn't the same as that one's; that one is a bit cheaper.
items.why: 一样 is a state predicate, so 不 goes right before it, after 跟那件. 也, 都 and 很 would claim the prices match, which contradicts 那件便宜一些.

items.q: 我昨天___在网上给妈妈买生日礼物，因为忘了密码。
items.zh: 我昨天没在网上给妈妈买生日礼物，因为忘了密码。
items.en: I didn't buy Mom's birthday present online yesterday, because I forgot the password.
items.why: A past event that did not happen takes 没 before the first coverb, 在网上. 不 would express habit or intention, and 还 (still) does not fit forgetting the password.

items.q: 我家___超市很近，走路只要三分钟。
items.zh: 我家离超市很近，走路只要三分钟。
items.en: My home is close to the supermarket; it takes only three minutes on foot.
items.why: The gap between two fixed places is 离 + place + 很近. 从 needs a movement or a start, 往 needs a direction verb, and 在 would mean located at.

items.zh: 爸爸从早上七点工作到晚上六点。
items.en: Dad works from seven in the morning until six in the evening.
items.why: 从 marks the start of a time span and 到 its end. 离 measures a gap and takes 远, 近 or 还有, and 在 does not pair with 到 here.

items.en: There are still two weeks until Spring Festival, and Mom has already started buying New Year goods.
items.why: A time gap to a coming event is 离 + event + 还有 + time. 从 marks a starting point and would be followed by 开始 or 到, not 还有.

items.zh: 从这家商场到我家要坐二十分钟公交车。
items.en: From this mall to my home it takes twenty minutes by bus.
items.why: 从…到… frames a route with a start and an end, and 要 + time gives the duration. 离 cannot follow 从 or pair with it.

items.zh: 爸爸昨天跟老同学见面了。
items.en: Dad met an old classmate yesterday.
items.why: 见面 cannot take an object; the other person is introduced with 跟 before the verb. 见面了老同学 is a classic learner error.
items.s_py: bà bà zuó tiān jiàn miàn le lǎo tóng xué
items.py: bà bà zuó tiān gēn lǎo tóng xué jiàn miàn le

items.s: 我住在奶奶家附近。
items.zh: 我住在奶奶家附近。
items.en: I live near Grandma's home.
items.why: 住 is a verb of staying, and 在 right after it marks the place one lives. It looks like the English order that is wrong elsewhere, but 住在 is standard.
items.py: wǒ zhù zài nǎi nǎi jiā fù jìn

items.s: 爸爸给我没买新手机。
items.zh: 爸爸没给我买新手机。
items.en: Dad didn't buy me a new phone.
items.why: 没 must go before the coverb phrase 给我, not between 给我 and 买. The same holds for 不, 也 and 都.
items.s_py: bà bà gěi wǒ méi mǎi xīn shǒu jī
items.py: bà bà méi gěi wǒ mǎi xīn shǒu jī

items.s: 妈妈昨天没在家做饭。
items.zh: 妈妈昨天没在家做饭。
items.en: Mom didn't cook at home yesterday.
items.why: 没 sits before the coverb phrase 在家, which is correct. It only looks odd to learners who expect the negative next to 做饭.
items.py: mā mā zuó tiān méi zài jiā zuò fàn

items.s: 奶奶家从我家很远。
items.zh: 奶奶家离我家很远。
items.en: Grandma's home is far from ours.
items.why: Distance between two places is 离. 从 marks where a movement or time span starts and cannot be followed by 很远.
items.s_py: nǎi nǎi jiā cóng wǒ jiā hěn yuǎn
items.py: nǎi nǎi jiā lí wǒ jiā hěn yuǎn

items.s: 离我家到商场要十分钟。
items.zh: 从我家到商场要十分钟。
items.en: It takes ten minutes from my home to the mall.
items.why: A route with a start and an end is 从…到. 离 measures a gap and never pairs with 到.
items.s_py: lí wǒ jiā dào shāng chǎng yào shí fēn zhōng
items.py: cóng wǒ jiā dào shāng chǎng yào shí fēn zhōng

items.s: 离超市还有两百米，我们走过去吧。
items.zh: 离超市还有两百米，我们走过去吧。
items.en: It's still two hundred metres to the supermarket; let's walk over.
items.why: 离 can open a clause when it measures a remaining distance with 还有. No 从 is needed, because nothing is traced as a route.
items.py: lí chāo shì hái yǒu liǎng bǎi mǐ wǒ men zǒu guò qù ba

items.s: 从我家到最近的商场，开车只要五分钟，走路却要半个小时。
items.zh: 从我家到最近的商场，开车只要五分钟，走路却要半个小时。
items.en: From my home to the nearest mall it takes only five minutes by car but half an hour on foot.
items.why: A route with a start and an end takes 从…到, even when the sentence then compares travel times. Nothing here is wrong.
items.py: cóng wǒ jiā dào zuì jìn de shāng chǎng kāi chē zhǐ yào wǔ fēn zhōng zǒu lù què yào bàn gè xiǎo shí

items.s: 我弟弟跟打游戏很感兴趣。
items.zh: 我弟弟对打游戏很感兴趣。
items.en: My younger brother is very interested in playing video games.
items.why: 感兴趣 takes its topic with 对. 跟 marks a partner in a mutual act, and 打游戏 is a topic, not a partner.
items.s_py: wǒ dì di gēn dǎ yóu xì hěn gǎn xìng qù
items.py: wǒ dì di duì dǎ yóu xì hěn gǎn xìng qù

items.s: 我对妈妈打电话了。
items.zh: 我给妈妈打电话了。
items.en: I called Mom.
items.why: The person receiving a call takes 给. 对 marks attitude or effect and cannot introduce the receiver of 打电话.
items.s_py: wǒ duì mā mā dǎ diàn huà le
items.py: wǒ gěi mā mā dǎ diàn huà le

items.s: 我想对爸爸说声谢谢。
items.zh: 我想对爸爸说声谢谢。
items.en: I'd like to say thank you to Dad.
items.why: 说 allows 对 as well as 跟 for the person addressed. 对爸爸说 is standard, so this is correct.
items.py: wǒ xiǎng duì bà bà shuō shēng xiè xiè

items.s: 这家店的售货员给我们介绍了很多新产品。
items.zh: 这家店的售货员给我们介绍了很多新产品。
items.en: The salespeople at this shop introduced many new products to us.
items.why: 介绍 to an audience takes 给 before the verb, and the phrase stays in front of 介绍了很多新产品. Nothing is wrong here.
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de shòu huò yuán gěi wǒ men jiè shào le hěn duō xīn chǎn pǐn

items.s: 我们应该往奶奶学习。
items.zh: 我们应该向奶奶学习。
items.en: We should learn from Grandma.
items.why: 往 needs a direction or place and a movement verb. Learning from a person takes 向.
items.s_py: wǒ men yīng gāi wǎng nǎi nǎi xué xí
items.py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng nǎi nǎi xué xí

items.s: 她朝我们招了招手，然后走进了商店。
items.zh: 她朝我们招了招手，然后走进了商店。
items.en: She waved at us and then walked into the shop.
items.why: 朝 can face a person, as in 朝我们招手. 往 would not work here, and the sentence has no error.
items.py: tā cháo wǒ men zhāo le zhāo shǒu rán hòu zǒu jìn le shāng diàn

items.s: 听说你买到房子了，我真对你高兴。
items.zh: 听说你买到房子了，我真为你高兴。
items.en: I heard you've bought a home, and I'm really happy for you.
items.why: Being happy on someone's account takes 为. 对你高兴 is not a Chinese pattern.
items.s_py: tīng shuō nǐ mǎi dào fáng zi le wǒ zhēn duì nǐ gāo xìng
items.py: tīng shuō nǐ mǎi dào fáng zi le wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng

items.s: 我坐自行车去超市。
items.zh: 我骑自行车去超市。
items.en: I ride my bike to the supermarket.
items.why: Bikes are ridden, so the verb is 骑. 坐 is for vehicles you sit inside, and using it for your own bike is a learner error.
items.s_py: wǒ zuò zì xíng chē qù chāo shì
items.py: wǒ qí zì xíng chē qù chāo shì

items.s: 妈妈用手机给我买了一件外套。
items.zh: 妈妈用手机给我买了一件外套。
items.en: Mom bought me a coat with her phone.
items.why: Two coverb phrases can stack before one verb: the tool 用手机 first, then the recipient 给我. The order feels crowded but is correct.
items.py: mā mā yòng shǒu jī gěi wǒ mǎi le yī jiàn wài tào

items.s: 我放手机在桌子上了。
items.zh: 我把手机放在桌子上了。
items.en: I put the phone on the table.
items.why: The phone ends up on the table, so 在 attaches to 放 and the definite object moves forward with 把. 放手机在 splits the verb from 在.
items.s_py: wǒ fàng shǒu jī zài zhuō zi shàng le
items.py: wǒ bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le

items.s: 请把零钱放在收银台旁边的小盒子里。
items.zh: 请把零钱放在收银台旁边的小盒子里。
items.en: Please put your change in the small box next to the cashier's counter.
items.why: 放在 + place keeps 在 glued to 放, with the object moved forward by 把. This is the target pattern, so it is correct.
items.py: qǐng bǎ líng qián fàng zài shōu yín tái páng biān de xiǎo hé zi lǐ

items.q: 我家___医院很近，走路五分钟就到。
items.zh: 我家离医院很近，走路五分钟就到。
items.py: wǒ jiā lí yī yuàn hěn jìn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào
items.en: My home is close to the hospital; it is five minutes on foot.
items.why: 离 gives the distance between two fixed points and takes 很近. 从 marks a starting point of movement, so 我家从医院很近 is wrong.

items.q: 夏天___六月开始，一直到九月。
items.zh: 夏天从六月开始，一直到九月。
items.py: xià tiān cóng liù yuè kāi shǐ yì zhí dào jiǔ yuè
items.en: Summer starts in June and runs until September.
items.why: 从…到 frames a span of time: 从 gives the starting month. 离 measures a gap and cannot introduce the start of a period.

items.q: ___冬天还有两个月，天气还不太冷。
items.zh: 离冬天还有两个月，天气还不太冷。
items.py: lí dōng tiān hái yǒu liǎng gè yuè tiān qì hái bù tài lěng
items.en: There are still two months until winter, so it is not very cold yet.
items.why: 离…还有 + time counts the gap before an event. 从 would need a movement or a span with 到, and it cannot be followed by 还有.

items.q: 这儿___药店只有三百米，走过去很快。
items.zh: 这儿离药店只有三百米，走过去很快。
items.py: zhè r lí yào diàn zhǐ yǒu sān bǎi mǐ zǒu guò qù hěn kuài
items.en: It is only three hundred metres from here to the pharmacy; it is a quick walk.
items.why: 有 + distance describes the gap between two places, which is 离. 从 would make 这儿 a starting point of a movement and does not take 有 + distance.

items.q: 医生说我要___明天开始吃这种药，每天两次。
items.zh: 医生说我要从明天开始吃这种药，每天两次。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ yào cóng míng tiān kāi shǐ chī zhè zhǒng yào měi tiān liǎng cì
items.en: The doctor says I have to start taking this medicine tomorrow, twice a day.
items.why: 从 + time + 开始 marks when a period begins. 离 would measure a gap between two points and cannot go with 开始 here.

items.q: ___我家到医院坐地铁只要二十分钟，所以我常去那儿锻炼身体。
items.zh: 从我家到医院坐地铁只要二十分钟，所以我常去那儿锻炼身体。
items.py: cóng wǒ jiā dào yī yuàn zuò dì tiě zhǐ yào èr shí fēn zhōng suǒ yǐ wǒ cháng qù nà r duàn liàn shēn tǐ
items.en: It only takes twenty minutes by subway from my home to the hospital, so I often go there to exercise.
items.why: A route with a start and an end is 从…到…. 离 does not pair with 到, so 离我家到医院 is ungrammatical.

items.q: 现在___下雪还有两个多月，你不用急着买羽绒服。
items.zh: 现在离下雪还有两个多月，你不用急着买羽绒服。
items.py: xiàn zài lí xià xuě hái yǒu liǎng gè duō yuè nǐ bù yòng jí zhe mǎi yǔ róng fú
items.en: There are still more than two months until it snows, so there is no hurry to buy a down jacket.
items.why: 离 + event + 还有 + time counts down to a future event. 从 cannot count the gap before something happens.

items.q: 台风昨天晚上___南边吹过来，风特别大。
items.zh: 台风昨天晚上从南边吹过来，风特别大。
items.py: tái fēng zuó tiān wǎn shang cóng nán biān chuī guò lái fēng tè bié dà
items.en: The typhoon blew in from the south last night, and the wind was very strong.
items.why: 从 + direction marks where the movement came from. 离 only measures a distance and has no movement; 对 and 给 need a person.

items.q: 我___早上到现在一直头疼。
items.zh: 我从早上到现在一直头疼。
items.py: wǒ cóng zǎo shang dào xiàn zài yì zhí tóu téng
items.en: I have had a headache all the time from this morning until now.
items.why: 从…到现在 gives the starting point of a time span. 离 needs a second point to measure the gap to; 在 cannot mark a starting time.

items.q: 太阳___东边慢慢升起来，雾也散了。
items.zh: 太阳从东边慢慢升起来，雾也散了。
items.py: tài yáng cóng dōng biān màn màn shēng qǐ lái wù yě sàn le
items.en: The sun slowly rose from the east and the fog cleared.
items.why: 从 + place marks where the movement begins. 往 would mean moving toward the east, the opposite meaning, and 离 has no movement.

items.q: 多晒太阳___身体好。
items.zh: 多晒太阳对身体好。
items.py: duō shài tài yáng duì shēn tǐ hǎo
items.en: Getting more sun is good for your health.
items.why: 对 marks what is affected, so 对身体好 means good for the body. 跟 marks a partner and 给 a recipient; neither fits an effect.

items.q: 弟弟发烧了，妈妈___老师打电话请假。
items.zh: 弟弟发烧了，妈妈给老师打电话请假。
items.py: dì di fā shāo le mā ma gěi lǎo shī dǎ diàn huà qǐng jià
items.en: My brother has a fever, so Mum phoned the teacher to ask for leave.
items.why: The person who receives a phone call is marked by 给 before 打电话. 对老师打电话 is not said.

items.q: 我___医生约好了明天上午见面。
items.zh: 我跟医生约好了明天上午见面。
items.py: wǒ gēn yī shēng yuē hǎo le míng tiān shàng wǔ jiàn miàn
items.en: I have arranged to meet the doctor tomorrow morning.
items.why: 见面 is mutual and cannot take an object, so the other person is marked by 跟 before it. 对 marks an attitude, not a partner.

items.q: 长期熬夜___心脏不好，你要早点儿睡。
items.zh: 长期熬夜对心脏不好，你要早点儿睡。
items.py: cháng qī áo yè duì xīn zàng bù hǎo nǐ yào zǎo diǎn r shuì
items.en: Staying up late for a long time is bad for the heart, so go to bed earlier.
items.why: 对 + body part + 不好 marks the thing affected. 给 would mean a recipient and 跟 a partner; neither marks an effect.

items.q: 她___运动一点儿也不感兴趣，更喜欢躺在沙发上。
items.zh: 她对运动一点儿也不感兴趣，更喜欢躺在沙发上。
items.py: tā duì yùn dòng yì diǎn r yě bù gǎn xìng qù gèng xǐ huan tǎng zài shā fā shàng
items.en: She is not the least bit interested in sport and prefers lying on the sofa.
items.why: 感兴趣 is an attitude toward something, so it takes 对. 向 needs a person or an abstract action like 学习, and 跟 means a partner.

items.q: 护士每天都___病人量体温。
items.zh: 护士每天都给病人量体温。
items.py: hù shi měi tiān dōu gěi bìng rén liáng tǐ wēn
items.en: The nurse takes each patient's temperature every day.
items.why: 给 marks the person a service is done for. 跟 would mean doing it together with the patient, which changes the meaning.

items.q: 我想___你聊聊最近的睡眠问题。
items.zh: 我想跟你聊聊最近的睡眠问题。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ liáo liáo zuì jìn de shuì mián wèn tí
items.en: I would like to chat with you about my recent sleep problems.
items.why: 聊 is a two-way activity, so the partner takes 跟. 给 would make you a recipient of a one-way action, and 往 needs a direction.

items.q: 医生___我说，这个病不严重。
items.zh: 医生对我说，这个病不严重。
items.py: yī shēng duì wǒ shuō zhè ge bìng bù yán zhòng
items.en: The doctor said to me that the illness is not serious.
items.why: 说 with a listener takes 对 (or 跟) before the verb. 往 and 从 mark direction or origin and cannot introduce a listener.

items.q: 下雨天我___朋友通了很长时间的电话。
items.zh: 下雨天我跟朋友通了很长时间的电话。
items.py: xià yǔ tiān wǒ gēn péng you tōng le hěn cháng shí jiān de diàn huà
items.en: On the rainy day I talked on the phone with a friend for a long time.
items.why: 通电话 is mutual, so the partner takes 跟. 对 would mark an attitude toward the friend, not the person you talk with.

items.q: 多喝热水___缓解感冒症状很有帮助。
items.zh: 多喝热水对缓解感冒症状很有帮助。
items.py: duō hē rè shuǐ duì huǎn jiě gǎn mào zhèng zhuàng hěn yǒu bāng zhù
items.en: Drinking more hot water is very helpful for relieving cold symptoms.
items.why: 有帮助 is an effect on something, so 对 marks what is helped. 给 is for a recipient and 从 for a starting point.

items.q: 出了医院，___右拐就是药店。
items.zh: 出了医院，往右拐就是药店。
items.py: chū le yī yuàn wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì yào diàn
items.en: Once you are out of the hospital, turn right and the pharmacy is there.
items.why: 往 + direction + movement verb 拐 gives the direction of travel. 从 would mean starting from the right, and 对 and 给 need a person.

items.q: 过马路时请先___左右看看。
items.zh: 过马路时请先往左右看看。
items.py: guò mǎ lù shí qǐng xiān wǎng zuǒ yòu kàn kàn
items.en: Please look left and right first when crossing the road.
items.why: 往 + direction + a verb of looking or going. 对 and 给 need a person, and 离 measures a distance.

items.q: 我要___医生请教一下怎么控制血压。
items.zh: 我要向医生请教一下怎么控制血压。
items.py: wǒ yào xiàng yī shēng qǐng jiào yī xià zěn me kòng zhì xuè yā
items.en: I want to ask the doctor how to control my blood pressure.
items.why: 向 + person goes with abstract verbs of asking and learning like 请教. 往 needs a place or direction, and 从 would mean a source of movement.

items.q: 孩子笑着___妈妈跑了过去。
items.zh: 孩子笑着朝妈妈跑了过去。
items.py: hái zi xiào zhe cháo mā ma pǎo le guò qù
items.en: The child ran toward Mum, smiling.
items.why: 朝 + person marks the direction faced in a movement. 从妈妈 would mean running away from Mum, and 对 and 给 do not mark a direction of running.

items.q: 风是从北边吹来的，我们___南走就不会那么冷。
items.zh: 风是从北边吹来的，我们往南走就不会那么冷。
items.py: fēng shì cóng běi biān chuī lái de wǒ men wǎng nán zǒu jiù bú huì nà me lěng
items.en: The wind is blowing from the north, so if we go south it will not be so cold.
items.why: 往 + direction + 走 marks where you head. 从南走 would mean leaving from the south, and 离 and 对 do not mark a direction.

items.q: 我们应该___运动员学习，每天坚持锻炼。
items.zh: 我们应该向运动员学习，每天坚持锻炼。
items.py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng yùn dòng yuán xué xí měi tiān jiān chí duàn liàn
items.en: We should learn from athletes and keep exercising every day.
items.why: 学习 needs 向 for the person you learn from. 往 needs a direction or place, and 对 or 给 cannot mark a teacher.

items.q: 你一直___前走，药店就在医院旁边。
items.zh: 你一直往前走，药店就在医院旁边。
items.py: nǐ yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu yào diàn jiù zài yī yuàn páng biān
items.en: Keep going straight ahead; the pharmacy is next to the hospital.
items.why: 往 + direction + 走 describes the direction of walking. 从前走 would not make sense, and 对 and 给 need a person.

items.q: 听说你的病好了，我真___你高兴。
items.zh: 听说你的病好了，我真为你高兴。
items.py: tīng shuō nǐ de bìng hǎo le wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
items.en: I heard you are better; I am really happy for you.
items.why: 为 marks the person on whose account you feel something. 对你高兴 and 给你高兴 are not said.

items.q: 外面下着大雨，妈妈很___我担心。
items.zh: 外面下着大雨，妈妈很为我担心。
items.py: wài miàn xià zhe dà yǔ mā ma hěn wèi wǒ dān xīn
items.en: It is pouring outside and Mum is very worried about me.
items.why: 为 marks the person behind a worry, so 为我担心. 往 and 从 mark direction and cannot carry a feeling.

items.q: 我感冒了，你可以___我去药店买药吗？
items.zh: 我感冒了，你可以替我去药店买药吗？
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào le nǐ kě yǐ tì wǒ qù yào diàn mǎi yào ma
items.en: I have a cold; can you go to the pharmacy in my place and buy some medicine?
items.why: 替 means doing something in someone else's place so that they do not have to. 对 marks an attitude and 往 and 离 are about direction and distance.

items.q: 明天我发烧去不了公司，你能___我请一天假吗？
items.zh: 明天我发烧去不了公司，你能替我请一天假吗？
items.py: míng tiān wǒ fā shāo qù bù liǎo gōng sī nǐ néng tì wǒ qǐng yī tiān jiǎ ma
items.en: I have a fever and cannot go to the office tomorrow; could you ask for a day off on my behalf?
items.why: 替我请假 means asking for leave on my behalf. 跟我请假 would mean asking me for leave, the opposite relation.

items.q: 医生们日夜工作，___大家的健康服务。
items.zh: 医生们日夜工作，为大家的健康服务。
items.py: yī shēng men rì yè gōng zuò wèi dà jiā de jiàn kāng fú wù
items.en: The doctors work day and night to serve everyone's health.
items.why: 为 marks the people you serve, as in 为大家服务. 对 would give an attitude, not a beneficiary.

items.q: 听到爷爷的手术很顺利，全家人都___他高兴。
items.zh: 听到爷爷的手术很顺利，全家人都为他高兴。
items.py: tīng dào yé ye de shǒu shù hěn shùn lì quán jiā rén dōu wèi tā gāo xìng
items.en: Hearing that Grandpa's operation went smoothly, the whole family was happy for him.
items.why: 为 marks the person you feel happy on behalf of. 对他高兴 is not said, and 从 and 往 mark direction.

items.q: 我感冒了，不能___冷水洗脸。
items.zh: 我感冒了，不能用冷水洗脸。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào le bù néng yòng lěng shuǐ xǐ liǎn
items.en: I have a cold and must not wash my face with cold water.
items.why: 用 marks the tool or material used. 坐, 骑 and 开 are for vehicles, not for water.

items.q: 下大雪，今天我们别骑车了，___公交车去医院吧。
items.zh: 下大雪，今天我们别骑车了，坐公交车去医院吧。
items.py: xià dà xuě jīn tiān wǒ men bié qí chē le zuò gōng jiāo chē qù yī yuàn ba
items.en: It is snowing hard, so let us not cycle today but take the bus to the hospital.
items.why: 坐 + vehicle means travel as a passenger. 开 would mean driving the bus yourself, and 骑 is for bikes.

items.q: 医生___一个小仪器检查我的耳朵。
items.zh: 医生用一个小仪器检查我的耳朵。
items.py: yī shēng yòng yí gè xiǎo yí qì jiǎn chá wǒ de ěr duǒ
items.en: The doctor examined my ear with a small instrument.
items.why: 用 + tool states the instrument used before the verb. 坐 is for vehicles and 给 would need a person.

items.q: 天气好的时候，我喜欢___自行车去公园锻炼身体。
items.zh: 天气好的时候，我喜欢骑自行车去公园锻炼身体。
items.py: tiān qì hǎo de shí hou wǒ xǐ huan qí zì xíng chē qù gōng yuán duàn liàn shēn tǐ
items.en: When the weather is nice, I like to ride my bike to the park to exercise.
items.why: Bicycles are ridden, so 骑. 开 is for cars you drive and 坐 for being a passenger; 往 is not a vehicle verb.

items.q: 医生让我___温水吃药，不要用茶。
items.zh: 医生让我用温水吃药，不要用茶。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ yòng wēn shuǐ chī yào bú yào yòng chá
items.en: The doctor told me to take the medicine with warm water, not with tea.
items.why: 用 + material states what you take the medicine with. 给 and 对 need a person, and 坐 is for vehicles.

items.q: 夏天中午我___外面跑步，太热了。
items.zh: 夏天中午我不在外面跑步，太热了。
items.py: xià tiān zhōng wǔ wǒ bù zài wài miàn pǎo bù tài rè le
items.en: In summer at noon I do not run outside; it is too hot.
items.why: 不 goes before the coverb phrase with an action verb: 不在外面跑步. 在不外面 breaks the phrase, and 对 and 给 need a person.

items.q: 他昨天___我打电话，所以我不知道他病了。
items.zh: 他昨天没给我打电话，所以我不知道他病了。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà suǒ yǐ wǒ bù zhī dao tā bìng le
items.en: He did not call me yesterday, so I did not know he was ill.
items.why: 没 goes before 给 and denies the past action. 不给 is not used for a single past event, and 给没我 breaks the phrase.

items.q: 这家医院离地铁站___，走路五分钟就到。
items.zh: 这家医院离地铁站不远，走路五分钟就到。
items.py: zhè jiā yī yuàn lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào
items.en: This hospital is not far from the subway station; it is five minutes on foot.
items.why: 远 is an adjective, so 不 goes right before it after the 离 phrase. 不近 would contradict 'five minutes on foot', and 没远 is not used.

items.q: 我对猫毛过敏，我妹妹___对猫毛过敏。
items.zh: 我对猫毛过敏，我妹妹也对猫毛过敏。
items.py: wǒ duì māo máo guò mǐn wǒ mèi mei yě duì māo máo guò mǐn
items.en: I am allergic to cat hair and my younger sister is allergic to it too.
items.why: 也 adds a second person with the same property and goes before 对. 都 needs a plural subject, and 更 and 才 do not mean 'also'.

items.q: 医生把检查结果发___我了，你看看邮箱。
items.zh: 医生把检查结果发给我了，你看看邮箱。
items.py: yī shēng bǎ jiǎn chá jié guǒ fā gěi wǒ le nǐ kàn kàn yóu xiāng
items.en: The doctor sent me the test results; check your email.
items.why: The recipient of a sent thing attaches to 发 as 给. 发在我 and 发到我 do not work with a person as the endpoint.

items.q: 雨太大了，哥哥开车把我送___医院。
items.zh: 雨太大了，哥哥开车把我送到医院。
items.py: yǔ tài dà le gē ge kāi chē bǎ wǒ sòng dào yī yuàn
items.en: It was raining too hard, so my brother drove me to the hospital.
items.why: 送到 + place says where the person ends up. 送在 and 送给 do not fit a place.

items.q: 他累得一躺___床上就睡着了。
items.zh: 他累得一躺在床上就睡着了。
items.py: tā lèi de yī tǎng zài chuáng shàng jiù shuì zháo le
items.en: He was so tired that he fell asleep as soon as he lay down on the bed.
items.why: 躺在 + place says where the body ends up lying. 给 and 对 need a person, and 往 cannot be glued to the verb here.

items.q: 请把你的症状写___这张纸上。
items.zh: 请把你的症状写在这张纸上。
items.py: qǐng bǎ nǐ de zhèng zhuàng xiě zài zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng
items.en: Please write your symptoms on this sheet of paper.
items.why: 写在 + surface marks where the writing ends up. 给 and 跟 mark people.

items.q: 医生把药方交___护士，护士去拿药。
items.zh: 医生把药方交给护士，护士去拿药。
items.py: yī shēng bǎ yào fāng jiāo gěi hù shi hù shi qù ná yào
items.en: The doctor handed the prescription to the nurse, and the nurse went to fetch the medicine.
items.why: 交给 + person marks who receives the thing. 交在 and 交到 need a place, not a person.

items.q: 冬天太冷了，妈妈把爷爷接___我们家住了一个月。
items.zh: 冬天太冷了，妈妈把爷爷接到我们家住了一个月。
items.py: dōng tiān tài lěng le mā ma bǎ yé ye jiē dào wǒ men jiā zhù le yí gè yuè
items.en: It was too cold in winter, so Mum brought Grandpa to our home for a month.
items.why: 接到 + place says where the person was brought. 接在 and 接给 do not mark a destination.

items.q: 她把退烧药还___了邻居，因为已经用不着了。
items.zh: 她把退烧药还给了邻居，因为已经用不着了。
items.py: tā bǎ tuì shāo yào huán gěi le lín jū yīn wèi yǐ jīng yòng bù zháo le
items.en: She returned the fever medicine to the neighbour because she no longer needed it.
items.why: 还给 + person gives the person it is returned to, followed by 了. 还在 would read as "still at" and 还到 needs a place.

items.q: 她把湿衣服挂___阳台上晾干。
items.zh: 她把湿衣服挂在阳台上晾干。
items.py: tā bǎ shī yī fu guà zài yáng tái shàng liàng gān
items.en: She hung the wet clothes on the balcony to dry.
items.why: 挂在 + place says where the clothes end up hanging. 给 and 跟 mark people.

items.q: 冬天我们常常___暖气房间里喝热茶。
items.zh: 冬天我们常常在暖气房间里喝热茶。
items.py: dōng tiān wǒ men cháng cháng zài nuǎn qì fáng jiān lǐ hē rè chá
items.en: In winter we often drink hot tea in a heated room.
items.why: The place where an activity happens takes 在 before the verb. 对 and 给 need a person.

items.q: 病人___病房里休息，请不要打扰。
items.zh: 病人在病房里休息，请不要打扰。
items.py: bìng rén zài bìng fáng lǐ xiū xi qǐng bú yào dǎ rǎo
items.en: The patient is resting in the ward; please do not disturb.
items.why: 在 + place marks where the resting happens. 跟 would mean resting with someone and 从 marks a starting point.

items.q: 下雨天他喜欢___朋友一起在咖啡馆看书。
items.zh: 下雨天他喜欢跟朋友一起在咖啡馆看书。
items.py: xià yǔ tiān tā xǐ huan gēn péng you yì qǐ zài kā fēi guǎn kàn shū
items.en: On rainy days he likes to read in a café together with friends.
items.why: 跟 + person + 一起 marks the companion before the verb. 对 and 给 do not mean doing something together.

items.zh: 弟弟在医院看病。
items.py: dì di zài yī yuàn kàn bìng
items.en: My brother is seeing a doctor at the hospital.
items.why: The place of the activity goes before the verb: 在医院看病. Putting 在医院 after 看病 is the English order and is wrong.

items.zh: 下雨天我跟妈妈在家包饺子。
items.py: xià yǔ tiān wǒ gēn mā ma zài jiā bāo jiǎo zi
items.en: On rainy days I make dumplings at home with Mum.
items.why: Both the companion and the place stand before the verb, in either order. Neither can follow 包饺子.

items.zh: 我坐地铁去医院。
items.py: wǒ zuò dì tiě qù yī yuàn
items.en: I go to the hospital by subway.
items.why: 坐 + vehicle comes first, then the movement 去医院.

items.zh: 这家医院离地铁站不远。
items.py: zhè jiā yī yuàn lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn
items.en: This hospital is not far from the subway station.
items.why: 远 is an adjective, so 不 sits right before it, after the 离 phrase.

items.zh: 我也想跟你们一起去爬山。
items.py: wǒ yě xiǎng gēn nǐ men yì qǐ qù pá shān
items.en: I want to go hiking with you too.
items.why: 也 and the modal 想 go before the 跟 phrase, and 一起去 follows it. 跟你们 cannot come after 爬山.

items.zh: 从这里到公园要十分钟。
items.py: cóng zhè lǐ dào gōng yuán yào shí fēn zhōng
items.en: It takes ten minutes from here to the park.
items.why: 从…到… frames a route, with 从 first and 到 after. 离 does not pair with 到.

items.zh: 离春天还有一个月。
items.py: lí chūn tiān hái yǒu yí gè yuè
items.en: There is still a month until spring.
items.why: 离 + event + 还有 + time counts the gap before something. 从 cannot do this.

items.zh: 过了红绿灯往左拐就到医院了。
items.py: guò le hóng lǜ dēng wǎng zuǒ guǎi jiù dào yī yuàn le
items.en: Turn left after the traffic lights and you will be at the hospital.
items.why: 往 + direction goes before the movement verb 拐. 往左 cannot follow 拐.

items.zh: 听到好消息我真为你高兴。
items.py: tīng dào hǎo xiāo xi wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
items.en: I was really happy for you when I heard the good news.
items.why: 为你 goes before the feeling word 高兴. 高兴为你 is not possible.

items.zh: 你能替我去药店买药吗。
items.py: nǐ néng tì wǒ qù yào diàn mǎi yào ma
items.en: Can you go to the pharmacy and buy medicine for me?
items.why: 替我 means in my place and goes before the verb it governs, so it can sit before or after 去药店. 吗 closes the question.

items.zh: 妈妈把药放在桌子上。
items.py: mā ma bǎ yào fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: Mum put the medicine on the table.
items.why: 放在 is glued together, with the place after it. The object moves forward with 把.

items.zh: 哥哥把我送到医院了。
items.py: gē ge bǎ wǒ sòng dào yī yuàn le
items.en: My brother took me to the hospital.
items.why: 送到 + place says where the person ends up. 了 comes at the end of the whole unit.

items.zh: 医生对我说多喝水对身体好。
items.py: yī shēng duì wǒ shuō duō hē shuǐ duì shēn tǐ hǎo
items.en: The doctor said to me that drinking more water is good for the body.
items.why: 对我 goes before 说, and 对身体好 is a second 对 phrase inside the quoted idea.

items.zh: 我晚上给妈妈打电话。
items.py: wǒ wǎn shang gěi mā ma dǎ diàn huà
items.en: I call my mother in the evening.
items.why: The receiver 给妈妈 goes before 打电话. 打电话给妈妈 is a different structure and not part of this drill.

items.src_py: zhè jiā yào diàn lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn
items.zh: 这家药店离我家不近。
items.py: zhè jiā yào diàn lí wǒ jiā bù jìn
items.en: This pharmacy is not close to my home.
items.why: 近 is an adjective, so 不 replaces 很 right before it, after the 离 phrase.

items.src_py: wǒ gēn péng you qù pá shān
items.zh: 我也跟朋友去爬山。
items.py: wǒ yě gēn péng you qù pá shān
items.en: I am going hiking with a friend too.
items.why: 也 goes before the coverb phrase 跟朋友, not before 爬山.

items.src_py: tā zài yī yuàn gōng zuò
items.zh: 他不在医院工作。
items.py: tā bù zài yī yuàn gōng zuò
items.en: He does not work at the hospital.
items.why: 不 goes before 在医院, not between 在医院 and 工作.

items.src_py: tā men yòng zhōng yào zhì gǎn mào
items.task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
items.zh: 他们用中药治感冒吗？
items.py: tā men yòng zhōng yào zhì gǎn mào ma
items.en: Do they treat colds with traditional Chinese medicine?
items.why: 吗 closes the sentence; 用中药 stays before the verb 治.

items.src_py: wǒ hěn dān xīn tā
items.zh: 我为他担心。
items.py: wǒ wèi tā dān xīn
items.en: I worry about him.
items.why: 为 + person goes before 担心 and marks the person the worry is about.

items.src_py: hē rè shuǐ duì gǎn mào yǒu bāng zhù
items.zh: 喝热水对感冒没有帮助。
items.py: hē rè shuǐ duì gǎn mào méi yǒu bāng zhù
items.en: Drinking hot water is not helpful for a cold.
items.why: The 对 phrase stays before 有, and 没 replaces it as 没有. 对感冒 cannot move after 帮助.

items.src_py: xiàng zuǒ guǎi jiù shì yī yuàn
items.zh: 往左拐就是医院。
items.py: wǎng zuǒ guǎi jiù shì yī yuàn
items.en: Turn left and that is the hospital.
items.why: 往 + direction + movement verb 拐 is the standard way to give a direction, and the phrase stays before the verb.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ yào fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
items.zh: 我没把药放在桌子上。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ yào fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: I did not put the medicine on the table.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, not before 放在, and 了 is dropped.

items.src: 妈妈寄了那件羽绒服给我。
items.src_py: mā ma jì le nà jiàn yǔ róng fú gěi wǒ
items.zh: 妈妈把那件羽绒服寄给我了。
items.py: mā ma bǎ nà jiàn yǔ róng fú jì gěi wǒ le
items.en: Mum sent me that down jacket.
items.why: The definite object moves after 把, and 寄给 + person stays glued together with 了 at the end.

items.s: 我吃药在家里。
items.s_py: wǒ chī yào zài jiā lǐ
items.zh: 我在家里吃药。
items.py: wǒ zài jiā lǐ chī yào
items.en: I take my medicine at home.
items.why: The place must come before the verb: 在家里 stands in front of 吃药. English puts the place last, but Chinese does not.

items.s: 他明天见面医生。
items.s_py: tā míng tiān jiàn miàn yī shēng
items.zh: 他明天跟医生见面。
items.py: tā míng tiān gēn yī shēng jiàn miàn
items.en: He is meeting the doctor tomorrow.
items.why: 见面 cannot take an object. The other person is marked by 跟 before the verb.

items.s: 我给朋友没发信息。
items.s_py: wǒ gěi péng you méi fā xìn xī
items.zh: 我没给朋友发信息。
items.py: wǒ méi gěi péng you fā xìn xī
items.en: I did not send my friend a message.
items.why: 没 must come before the coverb phrase 给朋友, not between it and the verb 发.

items.s: 这家医院不离我家远。
items.s_py: zhè jiā yī yuàn bù lí wǒ jiā yuǎn
items.zh: 这家医院离我家不远。
items.py: zhè jiā yī yuàn lí wǒ jiā bù yuǎn
items.en: This hospital is not far from my home.
items.why: 远 is an adjective, so 不 goes right before it: 离我家不远. 不离 is not said.

items.s: 离医院到我家要半小时。
items.s_py: lí yī yuàn dào wǒ jiā yào bàn xiǎo shí
items.zh: 从医院到我家要半小时。
items.py: cóng yī yuàn dào wǒ jiā yào bàn xiǎo shí
items.en: It takes half an hour from the hospital to my home.
items.why: A route with a start and an end is 从…到…. 离 measures a gap and does not combine with 到.

items.s: 我跟中医很感兴趣。
items.s_py: wǒ gēn zhōng yī hěn gǎn xìng qù
items.zh: 我对中医很感兴趣。
items.py: wǒ duì zhōng yī hěn gǎn xìng qù
items.en: I am very interested in traditional Chinese medicine.
items.why: 感兴趣 is an attitude toward something, so it takes 对. 跟 marks a partner in a mutual activity.

items.s: 他们往老医生学习。
items.s_py: tā men wǎng lǎo yī shēng xué xí
items.zh: 他们向老医生学习。
items.py: tā men xiàng lǎo yī shēng xué xí
items.en: They learn from the old doctor.
items.why: With a person and the abstract verb 学习 only 向 is possible. 往 needs a place or direction.

items.s: 她往我笑了笑。
items.s_py: tā wǎng wǒ xiào le xiào
items.zh: 她朝我笑了笑。
items.py: tā cháo wǒ xiào le xiào
items.en: She gave me a smile.
items.why: 往 needs a direction and real movement. Facing a person with a smile takes 朝 or 向.

items.s: 我们用公共汽车去医院。
items.s_py: wǒ men yòng gōng gòng qì chē qù yī yuàn
items.zh: 我们坐公共汽车去医院。
items.py: wǒ men zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù yī yuàn
items.en: We take the bus to the hospital.
items.why: Vehicles take 坐 (or 骑 for bikes). 用 is for tools and materials.

items.s: 他把湿外套挂了在椅子上。
items.s_py: tā bǎ shī wài tào guà le zài yǐ zi shàng
items.zh: 他把湿外套挂在椅子上了。
items.py: tā bǎ shī wài tào guà zài yǐ zi shàng le
items.en: He hung the wet coat on the chair.
items.why: 在 attaches directly to the verb: 挂在. 了 cannot come between them and goes after the whole unit.

items.s: 我把他送在医院了。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ tā sòng zài yī yuàn le
items.zh: 我把他送到医院了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ tā sòng dào yī yuàn le
items.en: I took him to the hospital.
items.why: 送 + place that he travels to needs 到, not 在. 送在 would describe a static position.

items.s: 我在医院旁边住了三年。
items.s_py: wǒ zài yī yuàn páng biān zhù le sān nián
items.zh: 我在医院旁边住了三年。
items.py: wǒ zài yī yuàn páng biān zhù le sān nián
items.en: I lived next to the hospital for three years.
items.why: 住 is one of the few verbs that allows the place before it as well as after (住在医院旁边), so this is correct.

items.s: 医生对每个病人都很耐心。
items.s_py: yī shēng duì měi gè bìng rén dōu hěn nài xīn
items.zh: 医生对每个病人都很耐心。
items.py: yī shēng duì měi gè bìng rén dōu hěn nài xīn
items.en: The doctor is patient with every patient.
items.why: 都 stays before the predicate after the 对 phrase because 耐心 is a state, and this is fine. Nothing needs to be moved.

items.s: 这个周末的天气跟上周一样冷。
items.s_py: zhè ge zhōu mò de tiān qì gēn shàng zhōu yī yàng lěng
items.zh: 这个周末的天气跟上周一样冷。
items.py: zhè ge zhōu mò de tiān qì gēn shàng zhōu yī yàng lěng
items.en: This weekend's weather is as cold as last week's.
items.why: 跟…一样 + adjective is the normal pattern, with the 跟 phrase before the predicate. Nothing is wrong.

items.s: 我对花粉过敏，对猫毛不过敏。
items.s_py: wǒ duì huā fěn guò mǐn duì māo máo bù guò mǐn
items.zh: 我对花粉过敏，对猫毛不过敏。
items.py: wǒ duì huā fěn guò mǐn duì māo máo bù guò mǐn
items.en: I am allergic to pollen but not to cat hair.
items.why: 不 goes right on the predicate 过敏, after 对猫毛. This is correct.

items.s: 我们应该向医生请教这个问题。
items.s_py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng yī shēng qǐng jiào zhè ge wèn tí
items.zh: 我们应该向医生请教这个问题。
items.py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng yī shēng qǐng jiào zhè ge wèn tí
items.en: We should ask the doctor about this question.
items.why: 向 + person goes with the abstract verb 请教, and the phrase comes before the verb. This is correct.

items.s: 我从昨天晚上开始咳嗽。
items.s_py: wǒ cóng zuó tiān wǎn shang kāi shǐ ké sòu
items.zh: 我从昨天晚上开始咳嗽。
items.py: wǒ cóng zuó tiān wǎn shang kāi shǐ ké sòu
items.en: I have been coughing since last night.
items.why: 从 + time + 开始 marks where a period starts. It is correct, and 离 would not work here.

items.s: 她朝窗外看了看，说下雨了。
items.s_py: tā cháo chuāng wài kàn le kàn shuō xià yǔ le
items.zh: 她朝窗外看了看，说下雨了。
items.py: tā cháo chuāng wài kàn le kàn shuō xià yǔ le
items.en: She looked out of the window and said it was raining.
items.why: 朝 + place + a verb of looking is correct; it is the direction she faced.

items.s: 夏天我从来不用冷水洗澡。
items.s_py: xià tiān wǒ cóng lái bù yòng lěng shuǐ xǐ zǎo
items.zh: 夏天我从来不用冷水洗澡。
items.py: xià tiān wǒ cóng lái bù yòng lěng shuǐ xǐ zǎo
items.en: In summer I never wash with cold water.
items.why: 不 goes before 用冷水, and 用 marks the material used. This is correct.

items.q: 他从小就___运动很感兴趣，所以身体一直都很健康。
items.zh: 他从小就对运动很感兴趣，所以身体一直都很健康。
items.py: tā cóng xiǎo jiù duì yùn dòng hěn gǎn xìng qù suǒ yǐ shēn tǐ yì zhí dōu hěn jiàn kāng
items.en: He has been very interested in sport since he was little, so he has always been healthy.
items.why: 感兴趣 is an attitude toward something, so 对 marks the object of interest. 跟 would mean a partner and 给 a recipient.

items.q: 因为下大雨，路上特别堵，所以我们决定___地铁去机场。
items.zh: 因为下大雨，路上特别堵，所以我们决定坐地铁去机场。
items.py: yīn wèi xià dà yǔ lù shàng tè bié dǔ suǒ yǐ wǒ men jué dìng zuò dì tiě qù jī chǎng
items.en: Because of the heavy rain the roads were jammed, so we decided to take the subway to the airport.
items.why: The subway is a vehicle you ride as a passenger, so 坐. 开 would mean driving it, and 用 is for tools.

items.src_py: wǒ sòng péng you dào huǒ chē zhàn le
items.zh: 我把朋友送到火车站了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ péng you sòng dào huǒ chē zhàn le
items.en: I took my friend to the railway station.
items.why: 把 brings the object before the verb, and 到火车站 stays attached to 送 as the place where the friend ends up.

items.s: 我们应该往老运动员学习。
items.s_py: wǒ men yīng gāi wǎng lǎo yùn dòng yuán xué xí
items.zh: 我们应该向老运动员学习。
items.py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng lǎo yùn dòng yuán xué xí
items.en: We should learn from the veteran athletes.
items.why: Learning from a person uses 向. 往 needs a place or direction and real movement, so 往 + person + 学习 is wrong.

items.s: 我家不离地铁站远。
items.s_py: wǒ jiā bù lí dì tiě zhàn yuǎn
items.zh: 我家离地铁站不远。
items.py: wǒ jiā lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn
items.en: My home is not far from the subway station.
items.why: 远 is an adjective predicate, so 不 sits directly on it, after 离地铁站. 不离…远 is not a Chinese pattern.

items.q: 这家书店___我家只有三百米，很方便。
items.py: zhè jiā shū diàn lí wǒ jiā zhǐ yǒu sān bǎi mǐ hěn fāng biàn
items.en: This bookshop is only three hundred metres from my home, which is very convenient.
items.why: 离…只有 + distance states the gap between two places. 从, 往 and 朝 describe movement and cannot be followed by 只有三百米 this way.
items.zh: 这家书店离我家只有三百米，很方便。

items.q: 小王常常___朋友一起踢足球。
items.py: xiǎo wáng cháng cháng gēn péng you yī qǐ tī zú qiú
items.en: Xiao Wang often plays football with his friends.
items.why: A partner in a shared activity (一起) is marked by 跟 or 和 before the verb. 在 marks a place, 往 a direction and 为 a beneficiary, so none of them fits 朋友一起.
items.zh: 小王常常跟朋友一起踢足球。

items.q: 他练了十年才拿到冠军，我们都___他感到骄傲。
items.py: tā liàn le shí nián cái ná dào guàn jūn wǒ men dōu wèi tā gǎn dào jiāo ào
items.en: He trained for ten years before winning the title, and we are all proud of him.
