items.why: Pride felt on someone's account takes 为: 为他感到骄傲. 给 and 跟 mark a recipient and a partner, and 往 a direction.
items.zh: 他练了十年才拿到冠军，我们都为他感到骄傲。
从我家到体育馆要二十分钟。
items.py: cóng wǒ jiā dào tǐ yù guǎn yào èr shí fēn zhōng
items.en: It takes twenty minutes from my home to the gym.
items.why: A route with a start and an end is 从…到, start first, and 要 plus the duration comes last. 离 could not take 到 here.

items.q: 他输了比赛，大家都___他难过。
items.py: tā shū le bǐ sài dà jiā dōu wèi tā nán guò
items.en: He lost the match and everyone feels sad for him.
items.why: A feeling felt on someone's behalf takes 为. 往 and 在 mark a direction and a place, and 对他难过 does not say that the sadness is for his sake.
items.zh: 他输了比赛，大家都为他难过。

items.src_py: wǒ duì yīn yuè gǎn xìng qù
items.task: Add 也 to say you are interested too.
items.zh: 我对音乐也感兴趣。
items.py: wǒ duì yīn yuè yě gǎn xìng qù
items.en: I am interested in music too.
items.why: 也 goes before the predicate 感兴趣, either right before the 对 phrase or just after it, but never after 感兴趣.

items.q: 我们___下午两点开始练习，一直练到五点。
items.py: wǒ men cóng xià wǔ liǎng diǎn kāi shǐ liàn xí yī zhí liàn dào wǔ diǎn
items.en: We start practising at two in the afternoon and keep going until five.
items.why: A period that starts at a time takes 从 for its start, matching 到 for its end. 离 measures a gap rather than marking a start, and 往 and 跟 do not take times.
items.zh: 我们从下午两点开始练习，一直练到五点。

items.s: 离比赛开始还有十分钟。
items.s_py: lí bǐ sài kāi shǐ hái yǒu shí fēn zhōng
items.zh: 离比赛开始还有十分钟。
items.py: lí bǐ sài kāi shǐ hái yǒu shí fēn zhōng
items.en: There are still ten minutes until the match starts.
items.why: 离 with 还有 gives the time left before an event. It has no subject, but it is a standard pattern; 从 would be wrong here.

items.q: 周末我要___朋友见面。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ yào gēn péng you jiàn miàn
items.en: I'm meeting a friend at the weekend.
items.why: 见面 is mutual, so the other person is a partner marked by 跟 or 和. 给 would make the friend a recipient and 对 an attitude target.
items.zh: 周末我要跟朋友见面。

items.q: 你放心去跑步吧，孩子我___你看着。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn qù pǎo bù ba hái zi wǒ tì nǐ kān zhe
items.en: Go for your run without worry; I'll watch the child for you.
items.why: 替 means doing the task in your place so that you don't have to. 对 and 往 do not express standing in for someone, and 离 measures distance.
items.zh: 你放心去跑步吧，孩子我替你看着。

items.s: 我们骑公共汽车去体育馆。
items.s_py: wǒ men qí gōng gòng qì chē qù tǐ yù guǎn
items.zh: 我们坐公共汽车去体育馆。
items.py: wǒ men zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: We take the bus to the gym.
items.why: A bus is ridden as a passenger with 坐. 骑 is only for bikes, horses and the like.

items.s: 我家从公园很远。
items.s_py: wǒ jiā cóng gōng yuán hěn yuǎn
items.zh: 我家离公园很远。
items.py: wǒ jiā lí gōng yuán hěn yuǎn
items.en: My home is far from the park.
items.why: Distance between two fixed places is 离. 从 marks where movement or time starts and cannot be followed by 很远.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ piào jiāo gěi lǎo shī le
items.zh: 我没把票交给老师。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ piào jiāo gěi lǎo shī
items.en: I didn't hand the ticket in to the teacher.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, and 了 is dropped. 交给 stays together after the verb.

items.s: 我们昨天没在公园遇到他。
items.s_py: wǒ men zuó tiān méi zài gōng yuán yù dào tā
items.zh: 我们昨天没在公园遇到他。
items.py: wǒ men zuó tiān méi zài gōng yuán yù dào tā
items.en: We didn't run into him in the park yesterday.
items.why: 没 goes before the coverb phrase 在公园, which is the standard slot for a negated action. The sentence is correct as it stands.

items.zh: 到了路口往左拐。
items.py: dào le lù kǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi
items.en: Turn left when you get to the junction.
items.why: 往 + direction comes before the movement verb 拐. The direction cannot follow it, as English 'turn left' does.

items.s: 这条路从火车站一直通到体育馆。
items.s_py: zhè tiáo lù cóng huǒ chē zhàn yī zhí tōng dào tǐ yù guǎn
items.zh: 这条路从火车站一直通到体育馆。
items.py: zhè tiáo lù cóng huǒ chē zhàn yī zhí tōng dào tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: This road runs all the way from the railway station to the gym.
items.why: A road has a start and an end, so 从…到 is right even though nothing physically moves. 离 would be wrong here.

items.src_py: tā men zài tǐ yù guǎn dǎ lán qiú
items.task: Say they do it every weekend.
items.zh: 他们每个周末在体育馆打篮球。
items.py: tā men měi gè zhōu mò zài tǐ yù guǎn dǎ lán qiú
items.en: They play basketball at the gym every weekend.
items.why: The time phrase comes before the place phrase, which comes before the verb.

items.src_py: xué xiào lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn
items.zh: 学校离我家不近。
items.py: xué xiào lí wǒ jiā bù jìn
items.en: The school is not close to my home.
items.why: 不 replaces 很 and sits directly on the adjective 近, after the 离 phrase.

items.q: 地铁站___这儿有两百米。
items.py: dì tiě zhàn lí zhè r yǒu liǎng bǎi mǐ
items.en: The subway station is two hundred metres from here.
items.why: 离 + place + 有 + distance states how far apart two points are. 从 describes where a movement starts and would need a verb such as 走.
items.zh: 地铁站离这儿有两百米。

items.src_py: wǒ zuò dì tiě qù gōng sī
items.task: Say you go by bike instead.
items.zh: 我骑自行车去公司。
items.py: wǒ qí zì xíng chē qù gōng sī
items.en: I go to the office by bike.
items.why: Bikes take 骑, not 坐, and the vehicle phrase still stands before 去.

items.q: 我家___公园很近。
items.py: wǒ jiā lí gōng yuán hěn jìn
items.en: My home is close to the park.
items.why: The gap between two fixed points, followed by 很近, is 离. 从 needs a starting point of movement or time and cannot be followed by 很近.
items.zh: 我家离公园很近。

items.src_py: jiào liàn gěi wǒ men dǎ diàn huà le
items.zh: 教练没给我们打电话。
items.py: jiào liàn méi gěi wǒ men dǎ diàn huà
items.en: The coach didn't call us.
items.why: 没 stands before the coverb 给我们, and 了 is dropped because 没 already says it did not happen.

items.zh: 我也想跟你们去踢球。
items.py: wǒ yě xiǎng gēn nǐ men qù tī qiú
items.en: I want to go and play football with you too.
items.why: 也 and the modal 想 come before the coverb phrase 跟你们, and the verb phrase comes last.

items.zh: 我们不坐出租车去体育馆。
items.py: wǒ men bù zuò chū zū chē qù tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: We're not going to the gym by taxi.
items.why: 不 goes before the coverb phrase 坐出租车, which stays before the verb. 坐出租车不去 would say something quite different.

items.q: 我们平时___在体育馆打乒乓球，都在公园打。
items.py: wǒ men píng shí bù zài tǐ yù guǎn dǎ pīng pāng qiú dōu zài gōng yuán dǎ
items.en: We usually don't play table tennis at the gym; we always play in the park.
items.why: 平时 describes a habit, so the negative is 不, placed before the coverb 在. 没 negates completed events and 别 is a command.
items.zh: 我们平时不在体育馆打乒乓球，都在公园打。
他对足球一点儿也不感兴趣。
items.py: tā duì zú qiú yī diǎn r yě bù gǎn xìng qù
items.en: He is not the least bit interested in football.
items.why: A fronted topic is fine, but 一点儿也不 stays right before 感兴趣, after the 对 phrase. The 对 phrase cannot follow the predicate.

items.s: 我送他在机场了。
items.s_py: wǒ sòng tā zài jī chǎng le
items.zh: 我送他到机场了。
items.py: wǒ sòng tā dào jī chǎng le
items.en: I took him to the airport.
items.why: A destination someone is taken to attaches to 送 as 到. 在 marks a static location, so 送他在机场 does not say where he was taken.

items.zh: 我弟弟用左手打乒乓球。
items.py: wǒ dì di yòng zuǒ shǒu dǎ pīng pāng qiú
items.en: My younger brother plays table tennis with his left hand.
items.why: The tool phrase 用左手 comes before the verb 打, not after the object as English 'with his left hand' would suggest.

items.q: 请___我们介绍一下这个公园的历史。
items.py: qǐng gěi wǒ men jiè shào yī xià zhè ge gōng yuán de lì shǐ
items.en: Please tell us a little about the history of this park.
items.why: The audience for an introduction is marked by 给 before 介绍. 从 and 往 mark a starting point and a direction, and 离 a distance, none of which is a listener.
items.zh: 请给我们介绍一下这个公园的历史。
我们想跟朋友一起去爬山。
items.py: wǒ men xiǎng gēn péng you yī qǐ qù pá shān
items.en: We want to go hiking with our friends.
items.why: The modal 想 comes first, then the partner phrase 跟朋友, then 一起 and the verb. The partner cannot follow 去爬山.

items.zh: 我每天坐地铁去公司。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě qù gōng sī
items.en: I go to the office by subway every day.
items.why: The vehicle phrase 坐地铁 comes before 去 and the destination. Putting 坐地铁 after 去公司 is English order and is wrong.

items.s: 他一直住在体育馆旁边。
items.s_py: tā yī zhí zhù zài tǐ yù guǎn páng biān
items.zh: 他一直住在体育馆旁边。
items.py: tā yī zhí zhù zài tǐ yù guǎn páng biān
items.en: He has always lived next to the gym.
items.why: 住 is one of the few verbs where 在 follows the verb, so 住在 is correct. Do not 'fix' it by moving the place before the verb.

items.s: 离我家到学校走路要十分钟。
items.s_py: lí wǒ jiā dào xué xiào zǒu lù yào shí fēn zhōng
items.zh: 从我家到学校走路要十分钟。
items.py: cóng wǒ jiā dào xué xiào zǒu lù yào shí fēn zhōng
items.en: It takes ten minutes on foot from my home to school.
items.why: A start-to-end route is 从…到. 离 measures a gap and cannot pair with 到.

items.q: 我明天有事，你能___我去参加比赛吗？
items.py: wǒ míng tiān yǒu shì nǐ néng tì wǒ qù cān jiā bǐ sài ma
items.en: I'm busy tomorrow; can you go and take part in the match in my place?
items.why: Acting in someone's place is 替. 跟 would mean going together with me, which contradicts the cue that I cannot go. 往 and 离 are direction and distance.
items.zh: 我明天有事，你能替我去参加比赛吗？

items.q: 到了红绿灯，请___右拐。
items.py: dào le hóng lǜ dēng qǐng wǎng yòu guǎi
items.en: At the traffic lights, please turn right.
items.why: A direction plus a movement verb (拐) takes 往. 对 and 给 mark a person, and 离 measures distance.
items.zh: 到了红绿灯，请往右拐。

items.s: 我跟游泳很感兴趣。
items.s_py: wǒ gēn yóu yǒng hěn gǎn xìng qù
items.zh: 我对游泳很感兴趣。
items.py: wǒ duì yóu yǒng hěn gǎn xìng qù
items.en: I'm very interested in swimming.
items.why: 感兴趣 takes its object with 对. 跟 marks a partner in a mutual act, and swimming cannot be a partner.

items.q: 周末我们打算___自行车去郊区玩。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ men dǎ suàn qí zì xíng chē qù jiāo qū wán
items.en: We plan to cycle out to the suburbs at the weekend.
items.why: Bicycles are ridden, so the verb is 骑. 坐 is for being carried in a vehicle, 开 is for driving one, and 用 names a tool.
items.zh: 周末我们打算骑自行车去郊区玩。

items.s: 你放心去比赛吧，我替你照顾孩子。
items.s_py: nǐ fàng xīn qù bǐ sài ba wǒ tì nǐ zhào gù hái zi
items.zh: 你放心去比赛吧，我替你照顾孩子。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn qù bǐ sài ba wǒ tì nǐ zhào gù hái zi
items.en: Go and play in the match without worry; I'll look after the child for you.
items.why: 替 means taking over a task in your place, so I look after the child instead of you. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 他刚___篮球场回来，满头大汗。
items.py: tā gāng cóng lán qiú chǎng huí lai mǎn tóu dà hàn
items.en: He has just come back from the basketball court, drenched in sweat.
items.why: The place a movement starts from is 从, here with 回来. 往 would mean towards the court, and 离 and 在 do not mark a point of departure.
items.zh: 他刚从篮球场回来，满头大汗。

items.q: 他做错了，应该___老师道歉。
items.py: tā zuò cuò le yīng gāi xiàng lǎo shī dào qiàn
items.en: He was wrong and should apologise to the teacher.
items.why: 道歉 is an abstract act aimed at a person, which is 向's job. 往 needs a place or direction and real movement; 在 and 离 do not mark a person.
items.zh: 他做错了，应该向老师道歉。

items.q: 我爸爸最近___一个老朋友商量开一家自行车店的事。
items.py: wǒ bà ba zuì jìn gēn yī gè lǎo péng you shāng liang kāi yī jiā zì xíng chē diàn de shì
items.en: My father has recently been discussing opening a bicycle shop with an old friend.
items.why: 商量 is mutual and takes 跟 or 和 for the partner. 对 and 给 cannot introduce a discussion partner, and 向 goes with abstract verbs like 学习 and 道歉, not 商量.
items.zh: 我爸爸最近跟一个老朋友商量开一家自行车店的事。

items.q: 雨太大了，我们别___自行车去了，___出租车吧。
items.py: yǔ tài dà le wǒ men bié qí zì xíng chē qù le zuò chū zū chē ba
items.en: The rain is too heavy; let's not cycle there but take a taxi.
items.why: Bikes are ridden (骑) and taxis are sat in (坐). Swapping them gives 坐自行车 and 骑出租车, and 用 or 开 do not fit either.
items.zh: 雨太大了，我们别骑自行车去了，坐出租车吧。

items.q: 他每个周末都___社区的篮球场___朋友打球。
items.py: tā měi gè zhōu mò dōu zài shè qū de lán qiú chǎng gēn péng you dǎ qiú
items.en: Every weekend he plays ball with his friends at the neighbourhood basketball court.
items.why: The place of the activity takes 在 and the playing partners take 跟, both before the verb. Reversing them, or using 给 or 对 for the friends, breaks the meaning.
items.zh: 他每个周末都在社区的篮球场跟朋友打球。

items.q: 去体育馆太远了，我们___公共汽车去吧。
items.py: qù tǐ yù guǎn tài yuǎn le wǒ men zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù ba
items.en: The gym is too far; let's take the bus.
items.why: A bus you ride in as a passenger takes 坐. 骑 is for bikes, 开 means driving it as the driver, and 用 names a tool.
items.zh: 去体育馆太远了，我们坐公共汽车去吧。

items.q: 出了地铁站，请___东走五分钟，就能看到那家书店。
items.py: chū le dì tiě zhàn qǐng wǎng dōng zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng jiù néng kàn dào nà jiā shū diàn
items.en: After leaving the subway station, walk east for five minutes and you'll see the bookshop.
items.why: 往 + direction + movement verb gives the way to go. 在东走 would put the walking at a place, and 对 and 给 mark people.
items.zh: 出了地铁站，请往东走五分钟，就能看到那家书店。

items.q: 老师把作业还___我们了。
items.py: lǎo shī bǎ zuò yè huán gěi wǒ men le
items.en: The teacher gave our homework back to us.
items.why: 还 plus a recipient needs 给 directly after the verb: 还给. 向 and 在 cannot follow 还 here, and 到 requires a place, not a person.
items.zh: 老师把作业还给我们了。

items.q: 我们周末___公园打篮球。
items.py: wǒ men zhōu mò zài gōng yuán dǎ lán qiú
items.en: We play basketball in the park at weekends.
items.why: The place where an activity happens is 在 plus the place, before the verb. 跟 needs a person and 往 needs a movement verb, so neither can introduce 公园 here.
items.zh: 我们周末在公园打篮球。

items.s: 我对足球不太感兴趣，对篮球也不感兴趣。
items.s_py: wǒ duì zú qiú bù tài gǎn xìng qù duì lán qiú yě bù gǎn xìng qù
items.zh: 我对足球不太感兴趣，对篮球也不感兴趣。
items.py: wǒ duì zú qiú bù tài gǎn xìng qù duì lán qiú yě bù gǎn xìng qù
items.en: I'm not very interested in football, and I'm not interested in basketball either.
items.why: With the state predicate 感兴趣, 不 and 也 sit between the 对 phrase and the predicate. That is the correct slot.

items.q: 明天有比赛，请你把参赛表交___张老师，再把我的球衣搬___体育馆。
items.py: míng tiān yǒu bǐ sài qǐng nǐ bǎ cān sài biǎo jiāo gěi zhāng lǎo shī zài bǎ wǒ de qiú yī bān dào tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: Tomorrow is the match; please hand the entry form to Teacher Zhang and carry my jersey over to the gym.
items.why: A person who receives is 交给; a place something is moved to is 搬到. Swapping them gives 交到张老师 and 搬给体育馆, which do not work.
items.zh: 明天有比赛，请你把参赛表交给张老师，再把我的球衣搬到体育馆。

items.s: 教练给我们没发通知。
items.s_py: jiào liàn gěi wǒ men méi fā tōng zhī
items.zh: 教练没给我们发通知。
items.py: jiào liàn méi gěi wǒ men fā tōng zhī
items.en: The coach didn't send us a notice.
items.why: 没 goes before the coverb 给我们, not after it, when the main verb is an action.

items.zh: 小王明天在体育馆打乒乓球。
items.py: xiǎo wáng míng tiān zài tǐ yù guǎn dǎ pīng pāng qiú
items.en: Xiao Wang is playing table tennis at the gym tomorrow.
items.why: Time, then place, then the action: 在体育馆 sits before 打乒乓球. English puts the place last, but in Chinese the phrase cannot follow the verb.

items.q: 教练把比赛的时间写___黑板上了。
items.py: jiào liàn bǎ bǐ sài de shí jiān xiě zài hēi bǎn shàng le
items.en: The coach wrote the match time on the blackboard.
items.why: The blackboard is where the writing ends up, so 在 attaches to 写. 给 would make it a recipient, and 从 and 对 cannot follow 写.
items.zh: 教练把比赛的时间写在黑板上了。

items.q: 他是___北京来的。
items.py: tā shì cóng běi jīng lái de
items.en: He is from Beijing.
items.why: The place someone comes from is the starting point of movement, so 从. 离 only measures distance and cannot go with 来.
items.zh: 他是从北京来的。

items.s: 她把自行车放在门口。
items.s_py: tā bǎ zì xíng chē fàng zài mén kǒu
items.zh: 她把自行车放在门口。
items.py: tā bǎ zì xíng chē fàng zài mén kǒu
items.en: She left her bicycle by the door.
items.why: The door is where the bike ends up, so 在 follows 放 directly, with 把 in front. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 请把书放___桌子上。
items.py: qǐng bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: Please put the book on the table.
items.why: 放 plus where the thing ends up takes 在 right after the verb. 给 would make the table a recipient, and 从 and 对 cannot follow 放.
items.zh: 请把书放在桌子上。

items.s: 他们打篮球在公园。
items.s_py: tā men dǎ lán qiú zài gōng yuán
items.zh: 他们在公园打篮球。
items.py: tā men zài gōng yuán dǎ lán qiú
items.en: They play basketball in the park.
items.why: The place of an activity must come before the verb. 打篮球在公园 copies English word order, and no native speaker says it.

items.q: 我弟弟从小就___游泳很感兴趣，现在天天去游泳馆。
items.py: wǒ dì di cóng xiǎo jiù duì yóu yǒng hěn gǎn xìng qù xiàn zài tiān tiān qù yóu yǒng guǎn
items.en: My younger brother has been interested in swimming since he was little and goes to the pool every day now.
items.why: 感兴趣 needs 对 for its object. 跟 and 给 mark a partner and a recipient, and 为 gives a beneficiary rather than a topic of interest.
items.zh: 我弟弟从小就对游泳很感兴趣，现在天天去游泳馆。

items.q: 妈妈把我的球鞋放___门口了。
items.py: mā ma bǎ wǒ de qiú xié fàng zài mén kǒu le
items.en: Mum put my sports shoes by the door.
items.why: The door is where the shoes end up, so 在 attaches to 放: 放在门口. 给 would make the door a recipient, and 对 cannot follow a verb.
items.zh: 妈妈把我的球鞋放在门口了。

items.q: 小李今天生病了，教练让我___他参加接力赛。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ jīn tiān shēng bìng le jiào liàn ràng wǒ tì tā cān jiā jiē lì sài
items.en: Xiao Li is ill today, so the coach asked me to run the relay in his place.
items.why: Taking someone's place is 替. 跟 would put us in the race together, which contradicts the fact that he is ill. 往 and 离 fit neither.
items.zh: 小李今天生病了，教练让我替他参加接力赛。

items.s: 他经常给我们介绍新的运动。
items.s_py: tā jīng cháng gěi wǒ men jiè shào xīn de yùn dòng
items.zh: 他经常给我们介绍新的运动。
items.py: tā jīng cháng gěi wǒ men jiè shào xīn de yùn dòng
items.en: He often introduces new sports to us.
items.why: 给 marks the people who receive the introduction and stands before 介绍. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 他右手受伤了，只好___左手写字。
items.py: tā yòu shǒu shòu shāng le zhǐ hǎo yòng zuǒ shǒu xiě zì
items.en: His right hand is hurt, so he has to write with his left.
items.why: The instrument used for an action is 用 + tool before the verb. 对, 给 and 往 mark a target, a recipient and a direction, none of which is a hand used as a tool.
items.zh: 他右手受伤了，只好用左手写字。

items.s: 你赢了，我真对你高兴。
items.s_py: nǐ yíng le wǒ zhēn duì nǐ gāo xìng
items.zh: 你赢了，我真为你高兴。
items.py: nǐ yíng le wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
items.en: You won; I'm really happy for you.
items.why: Being glad on someone's account is 为. 对 aims an attitude at a person and cannot go with 高兴.

items.q: 那个孩子一边哭一边___妈妈跑过去。
items.py: nà ge hái zi yī biān kū yī biān cháo mā ma pǎo guò qu
items.en: The child ran towards his mother, crying as he went.
items.why: Running while facing a person takes 朝 (or 向). 离 measures distance, 在 would place the running at the mother's side, and 给 marks a recipient.
items.zh: 那个孩子一边哭一边朝妈妈跑过去。

items.q: 我家离体育馆___远，走路只要五分钟。
items.py: wǒ jiā lí tǐ yù guǎn bù yuǎn zǒu lù zhǐ yào wǔ fēn zhōng
items.en: My home is not far from the gym; it only takes five minutes on foot.
items.why: With 离 the negative 不 sits on the predicate 远, after the coverb phrase. 很远 would contradict 'only five minutes on foot', 没 negates 有 or past events, and 别 is a command.
items.zh: 我家离体育馆不远，走路只要五分钟。

items.q: ___图书馆到火车站坐地铁要二十分钟。
items.py: cóng tú shū guǎn dào huǒ chē zhàn zuò dì tiě yào èr shí fēn zhōng
items.en: It takes twenty minutes by subway from the library to the railway station.
items.why: A route with 到 for its end needs 从 for its start. 离 does not pair with 到, and 在 and 对 cannot open a start-to-end pair.
items.zh: 从图书馆到火车站坐地铁要二十分钟。

items.q: 他昨天___我发了一条短信，问我周末去不去爬山。
items.py: tā zuó tiān gěi wǒ fā le yī tiáo duǎn xìn wèn wǒ zhōu mò qù bu qù pá shān
items.en: Yesterday he sent me a text asking whether I'd go hiking at the weekend.
items.why: The recipient of a message is marked by 给 before 发. 对 aims an attitude, 跟 marks a partner, and 往 needs a place.
items.zh: 他昨天给我发了一条短信，问我周末去不去爬山。

items.src_py: wǒ tì nǐ qù kāi huì
items.task: Ask a friend to do it for you: 你能…吗？
items.zh: 你能替我去开会吗？
items.py: nǐ néng tì wǒ qù kāi huì ma
items.en: Can you go to the meeting in my place?
items.why: The modal 能 comes before the 替 phrase, which stays before 去开会, and 吗 closes the question.

items.q: 他喜欢___筷子吃面条。
items.py: tā xǐ huan yòng kuài zi chī miàn tiáo
items.en: He likes to eat noodles with chopsticks.
items.why: A tool used to do the action takes 用 before the verb. 坐 is for vehicles, 在 for places and 给 for a recipient; chopsticks are none of these.
items.zh: 他喜欢用筷子吃面条。

items.q: 经常运动___身体很好。
items.py: jīng cháng yùn dòng duì shēn tǐ hěn hǎo
items.en: Exercising often is very good for your health.
items.why: 对…好 marks what something is good for. 跟身体好 and 给身体好 do not exist, and 向 only goes with people and abstract verbs.
items.zh: 经常运动对身体很好。

items.q: 医生说，每天散步半小时___身体有很大的帮助。
items.py: yī shēng shuō měi tiān sàn bù bàn xiǎo shí duì shēn tǐ yǒu hěn dà de bāng zhù
items.en: The doctor says that walking for half an hour a day is a great help to your body.
items.why: 对…有帮助 marks what is affected. 给身体有帮助 is not the pattern, and 跟 and 往 do not fit a benefit to the body.
items.zh: 医生说，每天散步半小时对身体有很大的帮助。

items.s: 比赛输了以后，她向大家道了歉。
items.s_py: bǐ sài shū le yǐ hòu tā xiàng dà jiā dào le qiàn
items.zh: 比赛输了以后，她向大家道了歉。
items.py: bǐ sài shū le yǐ hòu tā xiàng dà jiā dào le qiàn
items.en: After losing the match she apologised to everyone.
items.why: 道歉 is an abstract act aimed at people, which 向 marks, and 了 goes right after the verb 道. Nothing is wrong here.

items.q: 现在___比赛开始还有两个小时。
items.py: xiàn zài lí bǐ sài kāi shǐ hái yǒu liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.en: There are still two hours until the match starts.
items.why: 离 plus 还有 plus a time gives the time gap until an event. 往 and 对 do not measure gaps, and 给 marks a recipient.
items.zh: 现在离比赛开始还有两个小时。

items.q: 你一直___前走，过了桥就是银行。
items.py: nǐ yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu guò le qiáo jiù shì yín háng
items.en: Keep going straight ahead, and the bank is right after the bridge.
items.why: A direction (前) with a movement verb (走) takes 往. 对 and 给 mark people, and 离 is distance.
items.zh: 你一直往前走，过了桥就是银行。

items.q: 请___手机扫一下这个二维码。
items.py: qǐng yòng shǒu jī sǎo yī xià zhè ge èr wéi mǎ
items.en: Please scan this QR code with your phone.
items.why: The tool that does the scanning takes 用 before the verb. 坐 is for vehicles, 给 for a recipient and 往 for a direction.
items.zh: 请用手机扫一下这个二维码。
教练对我们很好。
items.py: jiào liàn duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
items.en: The coach is good to us.
items.why: The 对 phrase goes before the adjective, and 很 sits directly on 好. The target of the attitude cannot come after 好.

items.q: 他想___你商量一下比赛的事。
items.py: tā xiǎng gēn nǐ shāng liang yī xià bǐ sài de shì
items.en: He wants to discuss the match with you.
items.why: 商量 is mutual, so the partner takes 跟 or 和. 给 would make you a recipient and 对 an attitude target, neither of which suits 商量.
items.zh: 他想跟你商量一下比赛的事。

items.q: 我哥哥___篮球很感兴趣。
items.py: wǒ gē ge duì lán qiú hěn gǎn xìng qù
items.en: My older brother is very interested in basketball.
items.why: The object of interest is marked by 对: 对…感兴趣. 跟 would mean doing something together with basketball, which makes no sense.
items.zh: 我哥哥对篮球很感兴趣。

items.q: 我们应该___这位老运动员学习。
items.py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng zhè wèi lǎo yùn dòng yuán xué xí
items.en: We should learn from this veteran athlete.
items.why: Learning from a person is 向…学习. 往 needs a place or direction and real movement, and 离 and 在 do not mark the source of learning.
items.zh: 我们应该向这位老运动员学习。

items.src_py: mèi mei gěi wǒ fā duǎn xìn
items.zh: 妹妹不给我发短信。
items.py: mèi mei bù gěi wǒ fā duǎn xìn
items.en: My younger sister doesn't text me.
items.why: 不 goes before the coverb phrase 给我, not between 给我 and 发短信.

items.q: 昨天我把朋友送___地铁站，然后自己回家了。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ bǎ péng you sòng dào dì tiě zhàn rán hòu zì jǐ huí jiā le
items.en: Yesterday I saw my friend to the subway station and then went home alone.
items.why: 送 plus a destination takes 到 right after the verb. 送给 would mean giving the friend away to the station, and 在 does not mark arrival.
items.zh: 昨天我把朋友送到地铁站，然后自己回家了。

items.q: 我每天___地铁去上班。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě qù shàng bān
items.en: I go to work by subway every day.
items.why: A vehicle you ride in as a passenger takes 坐. 骑 is for bikes and horses, 开 means driving it yourself, and 用 names a tool, not transport.
items.zh: 我每天坐地铁去上班。

items.q: 我今晚想___你打电话。
items.py: wǒ jīn wǎn xiǎng gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.en: I want to call you tonight.
items.why: The person who receives a call is marked by 给 before 打电话. 对 would aim an attitude at you, and 往 and 从 need places.
items.zh: 我今晚想给你打电话。

items.q: 他笑着___我挥了挥手。
items.py: tā xiào zhe xiàng wǒ huī le huī shǒu
items.en: He smiled and waved at me.
items.why: Facing a person to do something to them takes 向 (or 朝). 往 needs a direction or place, and 从 and 离 are a starting point and a distance.
items.zh: 他笑着向我挥了挥手。

items.q: 你坐___这儿吧，这儿有空位。
items.py: nǐ zuò zài zhè r ba zhè r yǒu kòng wèi
items.en: Sit here; there is a free seat here.
items.why: 坐 plus the seat where one ends up takes 在 right after the verb. 给 would make 这儿 a recipient, and 对 and 从 cannot follow 坐.
items.zh: 你坐在这儿吧，这儿有空位。
教练昨天没给我们打电话。
items.py: jiào liàn zuó tiān méi gěi wǒ men dǎ diàn huà
items.en: The coach didn't call us yesterday.
items.why: With an action verb, 没 goes before the coverb phrase 给我们, not between 给我们 and 打电话.

items.q: 请你把这张票交___他。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè zhāng piào jiāo gěi tā
items.en: Please hand this ticket over to him.
items.why: 交 plus a recipient takes 给 right after the verb: 交给他. 在 and 到 need a place, and 对 cannot follow a verb.
items.zh: 请你把这张票交给他。

items.q: 听说你拿了冠军，我真___你高兴。
items.py: tīng shuō nǐ ná le guàn jūn wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
items.en: I hear you won the championship; I'm really happy for you.
items.why: Being glad on someone's account takes 为. 对 would aim the feeling at the person, which 高兴 does not allow, and 跟 is for partners.
items.zh: 听说你拿了冠军，我真为你高兴。

items.q: 比赛结束后，球员们___观众鞠躬，然后慢慢走出了球场。
items.py: bǐ sài jié shù hòu qiú yuán men cháo guān zhòng jū gōng rán hòu màn màn zǒu chū le qiú chǎng
items.en: After the match the players bowed to the crowd and then slowly walked off the pitch.
items.why: Bowing while facing people takes 朝 (or 向). 往 needs a direction word or place, 从 gives a starting point, and 跟 would mean bowing together with them.
items.zh: 比赛结束后，球员们朝观众鞠躬，然后慢慢走出了球场。

items.q: 教练___我们要求很严格。
items.py: jiào liàn duì wǒ men yāo qiú hěn yán gé
items.en: The coach is very strict with us.
items.why: 对…要求严格 uses 对 for the target of an attitude. 给 and 跟 mark a recipient and a partner, and the coach is not giving us the demands.
items.zh: 教练对我们要求很严格。

items.q: 他___房间里换衣服。
items.zh: 他在房间里换衣服。
items.py: tā zài fáng jiān lǐ huàn yī fu
items.en: He is changing his clothes in the room.
items.why: 在 + place goes before the verb to say where the action happens. 从 and 往 need a starting point or a direction of movement, and 离 compares distance, so none of them fits 换衣服.

items.q: 邻居每天早上___小区里跑步。
items.zh: 邻居每天早上在小区里跑步。
items.py: lín jū měi tiān zǎo shang zài xiǎo qū lǐ pǎo bù
items.en: My neighbour jogs in the housing complex every morning.
items.why: 在 + place before the verb gives the setting of the jogging. 跟 and 给 need a person, and 向 faces a person or direction, not a place where an activity happens.

items.q: 我周末想___新邻居一起去逛街。
items.zh: 我周末想跟新邻居一起去逛街。
items.py: wǒ zhōu mò xiǎng gēn xīn lín jū yī qǐ qù guàng jiē
items.en: I want to go shopping with my new neighbour at the weekend.
items.why: 一起 shows a companion doing the action together with you, so the coverb is 跟. 给 marks a recipient and 对 an attitude; neither can sit with 一起去.

items.q: 她每次都___朋友一起去商场挑衣服，从来不一个人去。
items.zh: 她每次都跟朋友一起去商场挑衣服，从来不一个人去。
items.py: tā měi cì dōu gēn péng you yī qǐ qù shāng chǎng tiāo yī fu cóng lái bù yī gè rén qù
items.en: She always goes to the mall with friends to pick out clothes and never goes alone.
items.why: The contrast with 一个人 shows a companion, and a companion before the verb is 跟. 为 is for whose sake, 给 for a recipient and 对 for an attitude, so none of them can pair with 一起去.

items.q: 那家店太贵了，以后我再也___在那儿买衣服了。
items.zh: 那家店太贵了，以后我再也不在那儿买衣服了。
items.py: nà jiā diàn tài guì le yǐ hòu wǒ zài yě bù zài nà r mǎi yī fu le
items.en: That shop is too expensive; I'll never buy clothes there again.
items.why: 不 negates a decision about the future and sits before the coverb phrase 在那儿. 没 would deny a past event, which clashes with 以后, and 别 is an order to someone else.

items.q: 我家离地铁站___远，走十分钟就到。
items.zh: 我家离地铁站不远，走十分钟就到。
items.py: wǒ jiā lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn zǒu shí fēn zhōng jiù dào
items.en: My home isn't far from the subway station; it's a ten-minute walk.
items.why: 远 is an adjective, so 不 sits right on it, after 离地铁站. 没 does not negate adjectives, and 很远 would say the opposite of a ten-minute walk.

items.q: 他对我___好，所以我不想跟他说话。
items.zh: 他对我不好，所以我不想跟他说话。
items.py: tā duì wǒ bù hǎo suǒ yǐ wǒ bù xiǎng gēn tā shuō huà
items.en: He isn't nice to me, so I don't want to talk to him.
items.why: 好 is the predicate, so 不 goes directly before it, after 对我. 没 does not negate an adjective, and 别 would be a command.

items.q: 昨天晚上邻居___给我打电话，我还以为他出门了。
items.zh: 昨天晚上邻居没给我打电话，我还以为他出门了。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang lín jū méi gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà wǒ hái yǐ wéi tā chū mén le
items.en: The neighbour didn't call me last night; I thought he had gone out.
items.why: A call that did not happen yesterday is denied with 没, placed before the coverb 给我. 不 does not report a specific past event, and 别 is a command.

items.q: 这条裙子的颜色跟我那条___一样，我想买下来。
items.zh: 这条裙子的颜色跟我那条不一样，我想买下来。
items.py: zhè tiáo qún zi de yán sè gēn wǒ nà tiáo bù yī yàng wǒ xiǎng mǎi xià lai
items.en: The colour of this skirt is different from my other one, so I want to buy it.
items.why: 不一样 negates the state 一样 and follows the phrase 跟我那条. 没 cannot negate 一样, and 很一样 is not said.

items.q: 我跟邻居关系很好，我丈夫___跟他们很熟。
items.zh: 我跟邻居关系很好，我丈夫也跟他们很熟。
items.py: wǒ gēn lín jū guān xi hěn hǎo wǒ zhàng fu yě gēn tā men hěn shú
items.en: I get on well with the neighbours, and my husband is close to them too.
items.why: 也 means 'too' and stands before the coverb phrase 跟他们, ahead of 很熟. 不 or 没 would contradict the good relations just mentioned, and 别 is an imperative.

items.q: 房东之前___对我们说过房租会涨，所以我们很意外。
items.zh: 房东之前没对我们说过房租会涨，所以我们很意外。
items.py: fáng dōng zhī qián méi duì wǒ men shuō guo fáng zū huì zhǎng suǒ yǐ wǒ men hěn yì wài
items.en: The landlord hadn't told us before that the rent would go up, so we were surprised.
items.why: The negative of 说过 (an experience) is 没, and it sits before the coverb 对我们. 不 cannot combine with 过 here, and 会 would make no sense with 过.

items.q: 你___给他打电话了，他正在开会。
items.zh: 你别给他打电话了，他正在开会。
items.py: nǐ bié gěi tā dǎ diàn huà le tā zhèng zài kāi huì
items.en: Don't call him again; he's in a meeting.
items.why: 别 makes a request and stands before the coverb 给他. 没 reports a past fact, while 也 and 都 do not make a request, so only 别 fits the situation.

items.q: 我家___学校很近。
items.zh: 我家离学校很近。
items.py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn
items.en: My home is very close to school.
items.why: 离 measures the gap between two places and is followed by 近 or 远. 从 needs a movement that starts there, and 往 needs a direction.

items.q: 房东___下个月开始收新房租。
items.zh: 房东从下个月开始收新房租。
items.py: fáng dōng cóng xià gè yuè kāi shǐ shōu xīn fáng zū
items.en: The landlord will start charging the new rent from next month.
items.why: 从 marks the point in time when something starts, here paired with 开始. 离 would count the gap to a date and go with 还有 + time instead.

items.q: 我家___超市有三百米。
items.zh: 我家离超市有三百米。
items.py: wǒ jiā lí chāo shì yǒu sān bǎi mǐ
items.en: My home is three hundred metres from the supermarket.
items.why: A distance between two fixed points is 离 + place + 有 + amount. 从 and 到 describe a journey, and 往 a direction.

items.q: 他___楼下走上来，手里拿着新衣服。
items.zh: 他从楼下走上来，手里拿着新衣服。
items.py: tā cóng lóu xià zǒu shàng lai shǒu lǐ ná zhe xīn yī fu
items.en: He walked up from downstairs with new clothes in his hands.
items.why: 从 marks where the movement starts, and 走上来 shows motion. 离 gives a gap, not a start, and 在 gives a fixed place, which does not fit 走上来.

items.q: 我现在住的地方___公司只有十分钟的路。
items.zh: 我现在住的地方离公司只有十分钟的路。
items.py: wǒ xiàn zài zhù de dì fang lí gōng sī zhǐ yǒu shí fēn zhōng de lù
items.en: The place where I live now is only ten minutes from the office.
items.why: 只有十分钟的路 states the gap between two places, which is 离. 从 would need a movement verb and 到.

items.q: ___我家到地铁站，走路要十五分钟。
items.zh: 从我家到地铁站，走路要十五分钟。
items.py: cóng wǒ jiā dào dì tiě zhàn zǒu lù yào shí wǔ fēn zhōng
items.en: From my home to the subway station it takes fifteen minutes on foot.
items.why: 从…到 frames a route from its start to its end, and the blank opens that frame. 离 never pairs with 到 to frame a route.

items.q: ___搬家还有一个星期，东西还没收拾好。
items.zh: 离搬家还有一个星期，东西还没收拾好。
items.py: lí bān jiā hái yǒu yī gè xīng qī dōng xi hái méi shōu shi hǎo
items.en: There is still a week until we move, and the things aren't packed yet.
items.why: 还有 + time after a point in time is the 离 pattern: the gap to moving day. 从 starts a period and 到 ends one, neither expresses the time left.

items.q: 这件大衣___去年冬天就一直挂在柜子里。
items.zh: 这件大衣从去年冬天就一直挂在柜子里。
items.py: zhè jiàn dà yī cóng qù nián dōng tiān jiù yī zhí guà zài guì zi lǐ
items.en: This coat has been hanging in the wardrobe ever since last winter.
items.why: 从…就一直 marks the starting time of a state that continues up to now. 离 would measure the gap to a time, which does not fit.

items.q: 这套房子___地铁站很近，但是从这儿到市中心要坐四十分钟的车。
items.zh: 这套房子离地铁站很近，但是从这儿到市中心要坐四十分钟的车。
items.py: zhè tào fáng zi lí dì tiě zhàn hěn jìn dàn shì cóng zhè r dào shì zhōng xīn yào zuò sì shí fēn zhōng de chē
items.en: This flat is very close to the subway station, but it takes forty minutes by car from here to the city centre.
items.why: 很近 describes a gap between two places, so 离. The second clause is a route with a start and an end, which is why it uses 从…到 instead.

items.q: 我们小区___大门进去，右边就是物业办公室。
items.zh: 我们小区从大门进去，右边就是物业办公室。
items.py: wǒ men xiǎo qū cóng dà mén jìn qu yòu bian jiù shì wù yè bàn gōng shì
items.en: Go in through the main gate of our complex and the property office is right there on the right.
items.why: 从 marks the entry point of a movement, 从大门进去. 离 gives a gap, and 在 gives a fixed place, so neither fits a verb of going in.

items.q: 房东___我们很好。
items.zh: 房东对我们很好。
items.py: fáng dōng duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
items.en: The landlord is very good to us.
items.why: 对 introduces the target of an attitude, followed by an adjective like 好. 给 needs a thing or service passed on, and 往 is for direction.

items.q: 我想___妈妈买一条围巾。
items.zh: 我想给妈妈买一条围巾。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gěi mā ma mǎi yī tiáo wéi jīn
items.en: I want to buy a scarf for my mum.
items.why: The receiver of something bought is marked by 给 before the verb. 对 would be an attitude, 跟 a partner and 向 a direction, none of which makes mum the recipient.

items.q: 我哥哥___运动鞋很感兴趣。
items.zh: 我哥哥对运动鞋很感兴趣。
items.py: wǒ gē ge duì yùn dòng xié hěn gǎn xìng qù
items.en: My older brother is very interested in sports shoes.
items.why: 感兴趣 takes its target with 对. 跟 would suggest a partner doing something together, and 给 a recipient.

items.q: 我下午要___房东商量一下房租的事。
items.zh: 我下午要跟房东商量一下房租的事。
items.py: wǒ xià wǔ yào gēn fáng dōng shāng liang yī xià fáng zū de shì
items.en: This afternoon I'm going to talk the rent over with the landlord.
items.why: 商量 is done together, so the other party is 跟 / 和 + person. 对 would be an attitude, 给 a recipient and 向 a direction; none can precede 商量 here.

items.q: 这种面料___皮肤很好，夏天穿特别舒服。
items.zh: 这种面料对皮肤很好，夏天穿特别舒服。
items.py: zhè zhǒng miàn liào duì pí fū hěn hǎo xià tiān chuān tè bié shū fu
items.en: This fabric is good for the skin and especially comfortable in summer.
items.why: Being good for something expresses an effect on it, which is 对. 给 would need something handed to the skin, and 跟 a partner.

items.q: 邻居常常___我们送一些自己种的菜。
items.zh: 邻居常常给我们送一些自己种的菜。
items.py: lín jū cháng cháng gěi wǒ men sòng yī xiē zì jǐ zhòng de cài
items.en: Our neighbour often gives us some vegetables he grew himself.
items.why: Vegetables handed over need a recipient, which is 给 + person before 送. 对 is an attitude and 跟 means doing it together with someone.

items.q: 我想___你介绍一下我们的新邻居。
items.zh: 我想给你介绍一下我们的新邻居。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ jiè shào yī xià wǒ men de xīn lín jū
items.en: I'd like to introduce our new neighbour to you.
items.why: 介绍 passes information to a person, so the receiver takes 给. 对 would be an attitude, and 跟 would mean introducing together with you.

items.q: 她从来不___别人比较衣服的价格，只买自己喜欢的。
items.zh: 她从来不跟别人比较衣服的价格，只买自己喜欢的。
items.py: tā cóng lái bù gēn bié rén bǐ jiào yī fu de jià gé zhǐ mǎi zì jǐ xǐ huan de
items.en: She never compares the prices of clothes with other people; she only buys what she likes.
items.why: 比较 is done between two parties, so the other party takes 跟. 对 would be an attitude, 给 a recipient and 为 whose sake, which makes no sense with 比较.

items.q: 穿太紧的裤子___身体不好，医生建议大家别穿。
items.zh: 穿太紧的裤子对身体不好，医生建议大家别穿。
items.py: chuān tài jǐn de kù zi duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo yī shēng jiàn yì dà jiā bié chuān
items.en: Wearing trousers that are too tight is bad for your health, and doctors advise against it.
items.why: The effect on the body is marked with 对, and 不好 follows it. 跟 and 给 would turn the body into a partner or a recipient.

items.q: 我已经___房东谈好了，下个月不用再交押金。
items.zh: 我已经跟房东谈好了，下个月不用再交押金。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng gēn fáng dōng tán hǎo le xià gè yuè bù yòng zài jiāo yā jīn
items.en: I've already settled it with the landlord, so there's no need to pay a deposit again next month.
items.why: 谈好 is an agreement reached together, so the other party takes 跟. 对 and 给 cannot mark a partner in a negotiation.

items.q: 出了大门，___右拐就是我家。
items.zh: 出了大门，往右拐就是我家。
items.py: chū le dà mén wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì wǒ jiā
items.en: Once you're out of the gate, turn right and that's my place.
items.why: 往 + direction + a verb of movement (拐). 在 marks a fixed place and 从 a starting point, so neither gives the direction of turning.

items.q: 我们应该___那位老邻居学习，他八十岁了还天天锻炼。
items.zh: 我们应该向那位老邻居学习，他八十岁了还天天锻炼。
items.py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng nà wèi lǎo lín jū xué xí tā bā shí suì le hái tiān tiān duàn liàn
items.en: We should learn from that elderly neighbour; at eighty he still exercises every day.
items.why: Learning from a person is 向 + person + 学习. 往 needs a direction or place, and 为 means for the sake of.

items.q: 我不小心把邻居的花瓶打碎了，赶紧___他道歉。
items.zh: 我不小心把邻居的花瓶打碎了，赶紧向他道歉。
items.py: wǒ bù xiǎo xīn bǎ lín jū de huā píng dǎ suì le gǎn jǐn xiàng tā dào qiàn
items.en: I accidentally broke my neighbour's vase and quickly apologised to him.
items.why: 道歉 is an abstract act addressed to a person, which is 向 + person. 往 needs a place or direction, 在 a location and 从 a starting point.

items.q: 你___前走五十米，就能看到那家服装店。
items.zh: 你往前走五十米，就能看到那家服装店。
items.py: nǐ wǎng qián zǒu wǔ shí mǐ jiù néng kàn dào nà jiā fú zhuāng diàn
items.en: Walk fifty metres straight ahead and you'll see that clothes shop.
items.why: 往前走 is the standard way to say 'head straight on'. 在前 would be a place, 从前 would read as 'formerly', and 对 faces a target.

items.q: 他走到门口，___我们挥了挥手就走了。
items.zh: 他走到门口，朝我们挥了挥手就走了。
items.py: tā zǒu dào mén kǒu cháo wǒ men huī le huī shǒu jiù zǒu le
items.en: He got to the door, waved at us and left.
items.why: 朝 + person + a gesture such as 挥手 means facing the people. 往 needs a place or direction, 从 a starting point and 为 means for the sake of.

items.q: 电梯坏了，请大家___楼梯口走，注意别摔倒。
items.zh: 电梯坏了，请大家往楼梯口走，注意别摔倒。
items.py: diàn tī huài le qǐng dà jiā wǎng lóu tī kǒu zǒu zhù yì bié shuāi dǎo
items.en: The lift is broken; please head for the stairs and be careful not to fall.
items.why: 往 + place + a verb of movement (走) gives the direction of travel. 在 would say the walking happens at the stairs, and 对 and 为 do not mark direction.

items.q: 听说你搬进新家了，我真___你高兴。
items.zh: 听说你搬进新家了，我真为你高兴。
items.py: tīng shuō nǐ bān jìn xīn jiā le wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
items.en: I heard you've moved into a new home; I'm really happy for you.
items.why: Being happy on someone's account is 为 + person + 高兴. 对 would aim the feeling at the person, which 高兴 does not allow, and 给 and 跟 do not mark feelings.

items.q: 你别___我担心，我自己能搬。
items.zh: 你别为我担心，我自己能搬。
items.py: nǐ bié wèi wǒ dān xīn wǒ zì jǐ néng bān
items.en: Don't worry about me; I can move it myself.
items.why: Worrying on someone's account is 为 + person + 担心. 对 cannot mark the cause of worry, and 给 needs a thing given to someone.

items.q: 我今天感冒了，你能___我去房东那儿交房租吗？
items.zh: 我今天感冒了，你能替我去房东那儿交房租吗？
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān gǎn mào le nǐ néng tì wǒ qù fáng dōng nà r jiāo fáng zū ma
items.en: I've got a cold today. Can you go to the landlord's to pay the rent for me?
items.why: Because I am ill, the friend would act in my place, which is 替. 对 would be an attitude and 跟 would mean going together with me.

items.q: 我们都___他搬进新家感到高兴。
items.zh: 我们都为他搬进新家感到高兴。
items.py: wǒ men dōu wèi tā bān jìn xīn jiā gǎn dào gāo xìng
items.en: We're all happy that he has moved into a new home.
items.why: 为 introduces the person or event that causes the happiness. 替 means doing something in someone's place, which makes no sense with 高兴.

items.q: 妈妈不在家，你可以___她把这件衣服收下来吗？
items.zh: 妈妈不在家，你可以替她把这件衣服收下来吗？
items.py: mā ma bù zài jiā nǐ kě yǐ tì tā bǎ zhè jiàn yī fu shōu xià lai ma
items.en: Mum isn't home. Could you take this piece of clothing in for her?
items.why: 替 means doing her job in her place while she is away. 对 would aim an attitude at her, and 跟 would mean doing it together with her.

items.q: 房东___住户服务了二十年，大家都很尊敬他。
items.zh: 房东为住户服务了二十年，大家都很尊敬他。
items.py: fáng dōng wèi zhù hù fú wù le èr shí nián dà jiā dōu hěn zūn jìng tā
items.en: The landlord has served the residents for twenty years, and everyone respects him.
items.why: 为 + people + 服务 means serving them for their benefit. 向 faces a person to learn or apologise, and 对 and 跟 do not fit 服务.

items.q: 他每天___公共汽车去学校。
items.zh: 他每天坐公共汽车去学校。
items.py: tā měi tiān zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù xué xiào
items.en: He goes to school by bus every day.
items.why: A vehicle you ride as a passenger takes 坐 before 去. 骑 is for bikes and 开 for driving, and 用 is for tools.

items.q: 她___筷子吃饭，不用叉子。
items.zh: 她用筷子吃饭，不用叉子。
items.py: tā yòng kuài zi chī fàn bù yòng chā zi
items.en: She eats with chopsticks and doesn't use a fork.
items.why: A tool used for the action takes 用 before the verb: 用筷子吃饭. 坐 is for vehicles, and 跟 and 给 mark people.

items.q: 我儿子每天自己___自行车去上学。
items.zh: 我儿子每天自己骑自行车去上学。
items.py: wǒ ér zi měi tiān zì jǐ qí zì xíng chē qù shàng xué
items.en: My son rides his bike to school by himself every day.
items.why: 自己 and a bicycle call for 骑, since he pedals it himself. 坐 would make him a passenger and 开 is for cars.

items.q: 搬家的时候，我们___一辆小卡车把家具运过去。
items.zh: 搬家的时候，我们用一辆小卡车把家具运过去。
items.py: bān jiā de shí hou wǒ men yòng yī liàng xiǎo kǎ chē bǎ jiā jù yùn guò qu
items.en: When we moved, we used a small truck to carry the furniture over.
items.why: The truck is the tool for moving the furniture, so 用 comes before the verb. 坐 would make us passengers, but the furniture is what travels.

items.q: 雨太大了，你___出租车回去吧，别走路了。
items.zh: 雨太大了，你坐出租车回去吧，别走路了。
items.py: yǔ tài dà le nǐ zuò chū zū chē huí qu ba bié zǒu lù le
items.en: The rain is too heavy; take a taxi back instead of walking.
items.why: Riding in a taxi as a passenger is 坐. 骑 is for bikes, 开 means driving it yourself, and 用 marks a tool.

items.q: 这件羊毛衫很容易缩水，最好___冷水手洗，不要放进洗衣机。
items.zh: 这件羊毛衫很容易缩水，最好用冷水手洗，不要放进洗衣机。
items.py: zhè jiàn yáng máo shān hěn róng yì suō shuǐ zuì hǎo yòng lěng shuǐ shǒu xǐ bù yào fàng jìn xǐ yī jī
items.en: This wool jumper shrinks easily, so it is best washed by hand in cold water, not put in the washing machine.
items.why: Cold water is the means of washing, so 用 comes before 手洗. 坐 is for vehicles, 往 for direction and 给 for a recipient.

items.q: 我把这封信寄___朋友了。
items.zh: 我把这封信寄给朋友了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ zhè fēng xìn jì gěi péng you le
items.en: I sent this letter to my friend.
items.why: 寄 + 给 + person: the friend is the receiver. 在 and 到 need a place, not a person.

items.q: 搬家公司已经把冰箱送___新家了。
items.zh: 搬家公司已经把冰箱送到新家了。
items.py: bān jiā gōng sī yǐ jīng bǎ bīng xiāng sòng dào xīn jiā le
items.en: The removal company has already delivered the fridge to the new home.
items.why: 送 + 到 + place: the fridge travels to the new home. 在 would say it stays there, and 给 needs a person.

items.q: 她把那件红色的外套挂___窗户旁边的衣架上了。
items.zh: 她把那件红色的外套挂在窗户旁边的衣架上了。
items.py: tā bǎ nà jiàn hóng sè de wài tào guà zài chuāng hu páng biān de yī jià shàng le
items.en: She hung that red coat on the hanger by the window.
items.why: 挂 + 在 + place says where the coat ends up hanging. 给 would need a person, and 着 or 过 cannot take a place after them.

items.q: 我已经把房租交___房东了，他还给了我一张收据。
items.zh: 我已经把房租交给房东了，他还给了我一张收据。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ fáng zū jiāo gěi fáng dōng le tā hái gěi le wǒ yī zhāng shōu jù
items.en: I've already paid the rent to the landlord, and he even gave me a receipt.
items.why: 交 + 给 + person: the landlord receives the rent. 在 and 到 mark a place, which would turn the landlord into a location.

items.zh: 小王明天在楼下等我们。
items.py: xiǎo wáng míng tiān zài lóu xià děng wǒ men
items.en: Xiao Wang will wait for us downstairs tomorrow.
items.why: The place phrase 在楼下 stands before the verb 等. The time word may come before or after the subject, but 在楼下 cannot follow 等我们.

items.zh: 我们想和房东谈房租。
items.py: wǒ men xiǎng hé fáng dōng tán fáng zū
items.en: We'd like to discuss the rent with the landlord.
items.why: The partner phrase 和房东 comes before 谈, after the modal 想. Putting 房东 after 谈 would make a different, wrong sentence.

items.zh: 她跟同学一起去买衣服。
items.py: tā gēn tóng xué yī qǐ qù mǎi yī fu
items.en: She's going to buy clothes with her classmates.
items.why: 跟同学 comes before 一起 and the verbs. 一起 cannot precede 跟, and 同学 cannot trail at the end.

items.zh: 他每个周末都在阳台上晒衣服。
items.py: tā měi gè zhōu mò dōu zài yáng tái shàng shài yī fu
items.en: He dries his clothes on the balcony every weekend.
items.why: 都 follows 每个周末 and 在阳台上 comes before 晒衣服. The place cannot be put after the verb.

items.zh: 我不想跟邻居吵架。
items.py: wǒ bù xiǎng gēn lín jū chǎo jià
items.en: I don't want to quarrel with the neighbours.
items.why: 不 and the modal 想 come before the coverb phrase 跟邻居. 吵架 takes no object, so the neighbour must be introduced with 跟.

items.zh: 他昨天没给房东打电话。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi gěi fáng dōng dǎ diàn huà
items.en: He didn't call the landlord yesterday.
items.why: 没 goes before the coverb 给房东, not between 给房东 and 打电话. The time word 昨天 may sit before or after the subject.

items.zh: 从我家到公司要四十分钟。
items.py: cóng wǒ jiā dào gōng sī yào sì shí fēn zhōng
items.en: It takes forty minutes from my home to the office.
items.why: A route with a start and an end is framed by 从…到. The duration 要四十分钟 comes last.

items.zh: 他对新邻居很热情。
items.py: tā duì xīn lín jū hěn rè qíng
items.en: He is very warm toward the new neighbours.
items.why: 对 + target comes before the adjective predicate 热情, and 很 sits on the adjective. 很 cannot precede 对.

items.zh: 你往前走一百米就到了。
items.py: nǐ wǎng qián zǒu yī bǎi mǐ jiù dào le
items.en: Walk a hundred metres straight ahead and you'll be there.
items.why: 往 + direction comes before the movement verb 走, and the distance follows the verb. 往 cannot come after 走.

items.zh: 你能替我给花浇水吗？
items.py: nǐ néng tì wǒ gěi huā jiāo shuǐ ma
items.en: Could you water the flowers for me?
items.why: The modal 能 comes before 替我, and the acting-in-my-place phrase precedes the verb 浇水. 替我 cannot come after 浇水.

items.zh: 他骑自行车去超市。
items.py: tā qí zì xíng chē qù chāo shì
items.en: He rides his bike to the supermarket.
items.why: How you travel comes first: 骑自行车, then the verb of going. The destination 超市 closes the sentence.

items.zh: 你可以用手机付房租。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī fù fáng zū
items.en: You can pay the rent with your phone.
items.why: The modal 可以 comes first, then the tool phrase 用手机, then the verb 付. 用手机 cannot follow 房租.

items.zh: 我们打算坐公共汽车去新家看看。
items.py: wǒ men dǎ suàn zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù xīn jiā kàn kan
items.en: We plan to take a bus to look at the new home.
items.why: 坐公共汽车 states the means before the verb 去. 打算 stays in front of the whole chain, and 坐公共汽车 cannot follow 去 or 看看.

items.zh: 我把外套挂在衣架上了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ wài tào guà zài yī jià shàng le
items.en: I hung the coat on the hanger.
items.why: 在 attaches directly to 挂 because the hanger is where the coat ends up. 了 can close the sentence or follow 在. 在衣架上 cannot move before 挂.

items.zh: 他把新买的沙发送到我家了。
items.py: tā bǎ xīn mǎi de shā fā sòng dào wǒ jiā le
items.en: He delivered the sofa he just bought to my home.
items.why: 到 attaches directly to 送 because my home is where the sofa ends up. 了 can follow 我家 or come right after 到, but 到我家 cannot stand before 送.

items.src_py: fáng dōng duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
items.task: Say he is not good to us.
items.zh: 房东对我们不好。
items.py: fáng dōng duì wǒ men bù hǎo
items.en: The landlord is not good to us.
items.why: 好 is an adjective predicate, so 不 goes right on it, after 对我们. Putting 不 before 对 gives a different, unnatural sentence.

items.src_py: xīn jiā lí dì tiě zhàn hěn yuǎn
items.zh: 新家离地铁站不远。
items.py: xīn jiā lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn
items.en: The new home is not far from the subway station.
items.why: 远 is the predicate, so 不 replaces 很 right before it, after 离地铁站. 不 cannot go before 离.

items.src_py: wǒ xiě xìn gěi xīn lín jū
items.task: Put the receiver before the verb with 给.
items.zh: 我给新邻居写信。
items.py: wǒ gěi xīn lín jū xiě xìn
items.en: I'm writing a letter to the new neighbour.
items.why: The default order puts the receiver in a 给 phrase before the verb: 给新邻居写信. Leaving 给 after 写信 is the English-style order.

items.src_py: tā kàn zhe wǒ xiào le xiào
items.task: Say he smiled toward me, using 朝.
items.zh: 他朝我笑了笑。
items.py: tā cháo wǒ xiào le xiào
items.en: He smiled at me.
items.why: 朝 + person faces the person with a physical gesture such as a smile. The phrase comes before the verb 笑, and 了 sits between the two 笑.

items.src_py: wǒ bāng nǐ qù jiāo fáng zū ba
items.task: Use 替: I'll go in your place.
items.zh: 我替你去交房租吧。
items.py: wǒ tì nǐ qù jiāo fáng zū ba
items.en: Let me go and pay the rent for you.
items.why: 替 + person means doing the job in that person's place, so it comes before the verb 交. 我替你去交 and 我去替你交 are both fine, but 替你 cannot follow 交.

items.src_py: tā zǒu lù qù gōng sī
items.zh: 他坐出租车去公司。
items.py: tā zuò chū zū chē qù gōng sī
items.en: He goes to the office by taxi.
items.why: A vehicle you ride in takes 坐 before the verb 去. 骑 and 开 are for bikes and driving yourself.

items.src: 我用洗衣机洗这件大衣。
items.src_py: wǒ yòng xǐ yī jī xǐ zhè jiàn dà yī
items.task: Say you don't use the washing machine for it.
items.zh: 我不用洗衣机洗这件大衣。
items.py: wǒ bù yòng xǐ yī jī xǐ zhè jiàn dà yī
items.en: I don't use the washing machine to wash this coat.
items.why: 不 negates the coverb 用 and goes right before 用洗衣机. It cannot go before the main verb 洗, which would deny the washing itself.

items.src_py: wǒ sòng le tā nà tiáo xīn wéi jīn
items.zh: 我把那条新围巾送给他了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà tiáo xīn wéi jīn sòng gěi tā le
items.en: I gave him that new scarf.
items.why: The specific scarf moves forward with 把, and the receiver follows the verb as 送给他, since he is where the scarf ends up. 了 closes the sentence.

items.src_py: chū zū chē sòng wǒ huí jiā le
items.task: Rewrite with 把: the taxi took me right to the foot of my building.
items.zh: 出租车把我送到楼下了。
items.py: chū zū chē bǎ wǒ sòng dào lóu xià le
items.en: The taxi took me right to the foot of my building.
items.why: 到 attaches straight to 送 because the building is where I end up. 了 may follow 楼下 or 到, and 楼下 cannot come before 送.

items.src_py: wǒ zài qiáng shàng guà le nà fú huà
items.task: Rewrite with 把 so the picture ends up on the wall.
items.zh: 我把那幅画挂在墙上了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà fú huà guà zài qiáng shàng le
items.en: I hung that picture on the wall.
items.why: Since the wall is where the picture ends up, 在 attaches directly to 挂 and the definite object moves forward with 把. 在墙上 cannot stay before 挂.

items.s: 我洗衣服在家。
items.s_py: wǒ xǐ yī fu zài jiā
items.zh: 我在家洗衣服。
items.py: wǒ zài jiā xǐ yī fu
items.en: I wash my clothes at home.
items.why: The place where an activity happens goes before the verb. English puts 'at home' last, but 在家 must come before 洗衣服.

items.s: 我明天见面邻居。
items.s_py: wǒ míng tiān jiàn miàn lín jū
items.zh: 我明天跟邻居见面。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān gēn lín jū jiàn miàn
items.en: I'm meeting the neighbour tomorrow.
items.why: 见面 cannot take an object, so the other person must be introduced with 跟 or 和 before the verb.

items.s: 邻居们常常在楼下一起聊天。
items.s_py: lín jū men cháng cháng zài lóu xià yī qǐ liáo tiān
items.zh: 邻居们常常在楼下一起聊天。
items.py: lín jū men cháng cháng zài lóu xià yī qǐ liáo tiān
items.en: The neighbours often chat together downstairs.
items.why: The adverb 常常 comes before the place phrase 在楼下, which is followed by 一起 and the verb. Every phrase is in front of 聊天, as it should be.

items.s: 我们跟房东在电话里谈了房租的事。
items.s_py: wǒ men gēn fáng dōng zài diàn huà lǐ tán le fáng zū de shì
items.zh: 我们跟房东在电话里谈了房租的事。
items.py: wǒ men gēn fáng dōng zài diàn huà lǐ tán le fáng zū de shì
items.en: We discussed the rent with the landlord on the phone.
items.why: Both the partner phrase 跟房东 and the place phrase 在电话里 stand before the verb 谈. Two coverb phrases can be stacked in front of one verb.

items.s: 房东上个月给我们没寄收据，我们很生气。
items.s_py: fáng dōng shàng gè yuè gěi wǒ men méi jì shōu jù wǒ men hěn shēng qì
items.zh: 房东上个月没给我们寄收据，我们很生气。
items.py: fáng dōng shàng gè yuè méi gěi wǒ men jì shōu jù wǒ men hěn shēng qì
items.en: The landlord didn't send us a receipt last month, and we were angry.
items.why: With an action verb, 没 goes before the coverb phrase 给我们, not between it and 寄.

items.s: 我对这件外套的颜色不太满意，可是对价格很满意。
items.s_py: wǒ duì zhè jiàn wài tào de yán sè bù tài mǎn yì kě shì duì jià gé hěn mǎn yì
items.zh: 我对这件外套的颜色不太满意，可是对价格很满意。
items.py: wǒ duì zhè jiàn wài tào de yán sè bù tài mǎn yì kě shì duì jià gé hěn mǎn yì
items.en: I'm not very satisfied with the colour of this coat, but I'm very satisfied with the price.
items.why: 满意 is a state predicate, so 不太 and 很 go directly on it after the 对 phrase. That is correct for adjective-type predicates.

items.s: 新房子从地铁站很远。
items.s_py: xīn fáng zi cóng dì tiě zhàn hěn yuǎn
items.zh: 新房子离地铁站很远。
items.py: xīn fáng zi lí dì tiě zhàn hěn yuǎn
items.en: The new flat is far from the subway station.
items.why: The distance between two places is 离, followed by 很远. 从 only marks a starting point of movement or time.

items.s: 这家店离我家很近，从我家走过去只要五分钟。
items.s_py: zhè jiā diàn lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn cóng wǒ jiā zǒu guò qu zhǐ yào wǔ fēn zhōng
items.zh: 这家店离我家很近，从我家走过去只要五分钟。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn cóng wǒ jiā zǒu guò qu zhǐ yào wǔ fēn zhōng
items.en: This shop is very close to my home; it's only five minutes on foot from my home.
items.why: 离 states the gap, 很近, and 从 marks where the walk starts. Each word does its own job even though both mean 'from'.

items.s: 我对邻居商量搬家的事。
items.s_py: wǒ duì lín jū shāng liang bān jiā de shì
items.zh: 我跟邻居商量搬家的事。
items.py: wǒ gēn lín jū shāng liang bān jiā de shì
items.en: I'm discussing the move with my neighbour.
items.why: 商量 is something done together, so the other party takes 跟 or 和. 对 marks an attitude or target, not a discussion partner.

items.s: 我弟弟跟打扮很感兴趣。
items.s_py: wǒ dì di gēn dǎ bàn hěn gǎn xìng qù
items.zh: 我弟弟对打扮很感兴趣。
items.py: wǒ dì di duì dǎ bàn hěn gǎn xìng qù
items.en: My younger brother is very interested in dressing up.
items.why: 感兴趣 takes its target with 对. 跟 is for a partner in a shared activity and cannot mark the topic of interest.

items.s: 房东对我们说，下个月要来检查水管。
items.s_py: fáng dōng duì wǒ men shuō xià gè yuè yào lái jiǎn chá shuǐ guǎn
items.zh: 房东对我们说，下个月要来检查水管。
items.py: fáng dōng duì wǒ men shuō xià gè yuè yào lái jiǎn chá shuǐ guǎn
items.en: The landlord told us he will come to check the water pipes next month.
items.why: With 说, 对 marks the listener and is standard, just like 跟我们说. The phrase sits before the verb.

items.s: 我想往邻居学习怎么做饭。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎng wǎng lín jū xué xí zěn me zuò fàn
items.zh: 我想向邻居学习怎么做饭。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng xiàng lín jū xué xí zěn me zuò fàn
items.en: I want to learn how to cook from my neighbour.
items.why: 往 needs a direction or place and a movement verb. Learning from a person takes 向.

items.s: 她朝我们走过来，手里提着一大袋衣服。
items.s_py: tā cháo wǒ men zǒu guò lai shǒu lǐ tí zhe yī dà dài yī fu
items.zh: 她朝我们走过来，手里提着一大袋衣服。
items.py: tā cháo wǒ men zǒu guò lai shǒu lǐ tí zhe yī dà dài yī fu
items.en: She walked toward us with a big bag of clothes in her hand.
items.why: 朝 can face a person and combines with a movement verb like 走过来. This is correct, even though 往 would not take 我们.

items.s: 看到你搬进新家，我真对你高兴。
items.s_py: kàn dào nǐ bān jìn xīn jiā wǒ zhēn duì nǐ gāo xìng
items.zh: 看到你搬进新家，我真为你高兴。
items.py: kàn dào nǐ bān jìn xīn jiā wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
items.en: Seeing you move into a new home, I'm really happy for you.
items.why: Being happy on someone's account takes 为. 对 would aim the feeling at the person, which 高兴 does not allow.

items.s: 我生病了，朋友替我去交了房租。
items.s_py: wǒ shēng bìng le péng you tì wǒ qù jiāo le fáng zū
items.zh: 我生病了，朋友替我去交了房租。
items.py: wǒ shēng bìng le péng you tì wǒ qù jiāo le fáng zū
items.en: I was ill, so a friend went to pay the rent for me.
items.why: 替 means acting in someone's place, which is exactly the situation here: I was ill, so my friend did it instead of me.

items.s: 我们周末用地铁去逛街。
items.s_py: wǒ men zhōu mò yòng dì tiě qù guàng jiē
items.zh: 我们周末坐地铁去逛街。
items.py: wǒ men zhōu mò zuò dì tiě qù guàng jiē
items.en: We take the subway to go shopping at the weekend.
items.why: A vehicle you ride in takes 坐, not 用. 用 is for tools used to carry out the action.

items.s: 这件丝绸衬衫太贵了，所以我只用手洗，不用洗衣机。
items.s_py: zhè jiàn sī chóu chèn shān tài guì le suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǐ yòng shǒu xǐ bù yòng xǐ yī jī
items.zh: 这件丝绸衬衫太贵了，所以我只用手洗，不用洗衣机。
items.py: zhè jiàn sī chóu chèn shān tài guì le suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǐ yòng shǒu xǐ bù yòng xǐ yī jī
items.en: This silk shirt is too expensive, so I only wash it by hand and don't use the washing machine.
items.why: The tools are 手 and 洗衣机, both marked with 用 before the verb. 不 and 只 stand before 用.

items.s: 他把名字在门上写了。
items.s_py: tā bǎ míng zi zài mén shàng xiě le
items.zh: 他把名字写在门上了。
items.py: tā bǎ míng zi xiě zài mén shàng le
items.en: He wrote his name on the door.
items.why: The door is where the name ends up, so 在 must attach directly to 写. 在门上 cannot come before the verb after 把.

items.s: 她把洗好的衣服一件一件挂在了阳台上。
items.s_py: tā bǎ xǐ hǎo de yī fu yī jiàn yī jiàn guà zài le yáng tái shàng
items.zh: 她把洗好的衣服一件一件挂在了阳台上。
